articles.title: UltraTex: Aligning Physical Knowledge for High-Fidelity PBR Texture Generation
articles.content: Generating physically based rendering (PBR) texture maps for a 3D mesh from a single reference image is highly ambiguous, as the observed appearance entangles material identity, surface reflectance, and illumination. While current generative methods produce realistic albedo maps, they still struggle to infer accurate metallic and roughness attributes for relighting. We present UltraTex, a cascaded multi-view framework that moves beyond appearance matching by integrating physical knowledge into multi-view diffusion-based PBR generation. UltraTex first jointly predicts albedo and world-space shading normals to generate more detailed albedo maps, and then predicts metallic-roughness (MR) maps conditioned on the generated albedo, reference image, and material semantic priors. To inject material semantics, a lightweight adapter transforms hidden-layer features of a vision-language model (VLM) into intrinsic material representation tokens, providing part-level knowledge anchors for MR estimation. To model material-light interaction, photometric representation alignment guides intermediate diffusion features toward ground-truth material renderings under controlled lighting. This makes metallic and roughness variations observable through highlight intensity, specular sharpness, and local reflectance contrast, providing stronger guidance for fine-grained material prediction without explicit lighting supervision. Extensive experiments show that UltraTex generates high-quality textures and outperforms existing open-source and commercial methods in visual fidelity, material accuracy, and physical plausibility.

articles.title_zh: UltraTex: 调和物理知识用于高纯度 PBR 纹理生成
articles.content_zh: 从单一的参考图像中生成一个3D网格的物理渲染(PBR)纹理图非常模糊,因为观测到的外观缠绕了物质身份,表面反射,以及照明. 虽然目前的基因方法产生了现实的反照率图,但它们仍然难以推断出准确的金属和粗糙度属性来重新点亮. 我们介绍UltraTex,这是一个级联的多视图框架,通过将物理知识整合到基于多视图传播的PBR生成中,超越外观匹配. UltraTex公司首先联合预测反照率和世界空间阴影常态,以生成更详细的反照率地图,然后预测以生成反照率为条件的金属槽(MR)地图,参考图像,以及材料语义学前传. 为了注入材料语义,一个轻量级适配器将视觉语言模型(VLM)的隐藏层特征转化为内在的物质表示符,为MR估计提供了部分层次的知识锚. 为了模拟材料与光的相互作用,光度表示对齐将中间扩散特征引导到受控照明下的地面真实材料渲染。 这使得金属和粗糙度的变化通过突出强度、光谱锋利度以及局部反射对比而明显可见,为未经明确照明监督的精细材料预测提供了更强有力的指导。 广泛的实验表明,UltraTex在视觉忠贞性,物质精度,和物理可信度方面产生高质量的纹理,并且超越现有的开源和商业方法.

articles.title: $Z$-sight: Unifying Vision-Language-Action and Latent World Modeling
articles.content: We introduce $Z$-sight, a unified robot foundation model that couples vision-language-action (VLA) and generative latent world modeling. Video-based world action models (WAMs) show the value of joint future-and-action generation for control, yet inherit the heavy cost of video generators. Recent latent-space policies avoid pixel generation, yet typically align intermediate features or rely on frozen target encoders, decoupling future prediction from the VLM's native feature space. $Z$-sight instead predicts the future directly in the visual token space in which its VLM perceives the present. Coupling a foresight expert and a continuous action expert with the VLM in a mixture-of-transformers, $Z$-sight jointly denoises future spatial tokens and actions at inference without pixel reconstruction or external encoders. Trained on human video and robot trajectories, $Z$-sight achieves 81.9% success on SIMPLE (+9.6 points over the strongest baseline) and 73.3% across six Unitree G1 tasks (+20.0 points) at 110 ms per chunk, while remaining competitive on tabletop benchmarks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 展望:统一愿景-语言-行动和后期世界建模
articles.content_zh: 我们引入了$Z$-sight, 一个统一的机器人基础模型, 夫妇视觉语言-动作(VLA)和基因潜伏的世界模型。 基于视频的世界行动模型(WAMS)显示了联合未来与行动生成对控制的价值,但继承了视频发电机的沉重成本. 最近的潜伏空间政策避免像素生成,但通常对接中间特性或依赖冷冻目标编码器,将未来的预测与VLM的本土特性空间脱钩. $Z$-sight则直接在它的VLM感知到现在的视觉符号空间中预测未来. 将一名展望专家和一名连续行动专家与转换器混合物中的VLM相配合,$Z$-sight共同将未来的空间符号和动作置于推论中,而无需像素重建或外部编码器. 接受人类视频和机器人轨迹训练,在SIMPLE(超过最强基线的+9.6分)和Unitree G1六项任务(+20.0分)上,美元视距达到81.9%的成功率,每块110米,同时在桌面基准上保持竞争力。

articles.title: Unified Law for Visual Tasks (The Four Laws of Computer Vision)
articles.content: In this paper, we propose a Unified Law for Visual Tasks, which could be further divided into Four Laws of Computer Vision, with the goal of enabling a single framework or method to uniformly train on and perform nearly all visual tasks. Our starting point is an inspiration and hypothesis: if the world information is encoded into image, which we call World Snapshots, then image processing is world processing, and image generation is World Snapshot generation. Furthermore, if all visual and visualization tasks can be reformulated as generation tasks, then a unified method, World Snapshot Models (WSMs), can perform the vast majority of visual tasks, much as large language models have largely unified natural language processing. This paper validates these laws across more than 1,000 trained and evaluated visual tasks (defined by distinct input-output mappings) and presents a unified training framework for future visual-task research and applications.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 视觉任务统一法 (计算机视野四法).
articles.content_zh: 在本文中,我们提出了"视觉任务统一法"(United Law for Visual Interviews),可以进一步划分为"计算机视觉四法"(Four Laws of Computer Vision),其目标是使单一的框架或方法能够统一培训和完成几乎所有的视觉任务. 我们的出发点是一个启发和假设:如果世界信息被编码成图像,我们称之为"世界快照",那么图像处理就是世界处理,而图像生成就是"世界快照"一代. 此外,如果所有可视化和可视化任务都可以重新制定为生成任务,那么一种统一的方法——世界快照模型(World Snapshot Models)(WSMs)可以完成绝大多数的可视化任务,就像大型语言模型已经基本统一了自然语言处理一样. 本文验证了1,000多项经过培训和评价的视觉任务(由不同的输入-输出绘图界定)的这些法律,并为未来的视觉任务研究和应用提供了一个统一的培训框架。

articles.title: PrismRestore: A Compact Restoration Toolbox for Agentic Image Restoration
articles.content: Agentic image restoration composes operations to handle mixed degradations, yet its toolbox often requires storing multiple restoration networks. We propose PrismRestore, which constructs a compact bank of callable restoration actions from a single frozen all-in-one model. Our approach builds on task-dependent yet overlapping channel responses in the shared model. An offline task-prior search uses activation and gradient statistics to group channels with similar response profiles, then searches task-specific modulation coefficients over non-representative channels while leaving representative channels unmodulated. The resulting prior bank enables explicit action selection and composition without additional restoration backbones or task-specific adapter modules. A state-conditioned policy learns to compose these actions using Group Relative Policy Optimization. Its objective separately normalizes fidelity and perceptual feedback within groups of trajectories sampled for the same input, and combines terminal evaluation with return-to-go derived from stepwise quality changes. Experiments on synthetic composite-degradation and real-world multi-task benchmarks show improvements over the evaluated all-in-one baselines and restoration quality competitive with multi-model agents. PrismRestore achieves these results with a single restoration backbone and faster inference than the evaluated agentic baselines.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PrismRestore: 代理图像修复的压缩还原工具箱
articles.content_zh: 代理图像修复会构成处理混合降解的操作,然而其工具箱往往需要存储多个修复网络. 我们建议PrismRestore从一个单一的冷冻全能模型中建立一个可呼恢复行动的紧凑银行。 我们的方法以共同模式中依赖任务但重复的渠道反应为基础。 离线任务前搜索使用激活和梯度统计来分组具有类似响应配置的频道,然后在非代表性频道上搜索特定任务调制系数,同时让代表性频道不进行调制. 由此形成的先前的库可以使明确的动作选择和组成不附加恢复主干线或任务特定的适配器模块. 一项有条件的政策学习了利用集团相对政策优化来组成这些行动。 其目标在为相同输入而取样的轨迹组内分别将忠诚度和知觉反馈正常化,并将终端评价与从阶梯质量变化中得出的回转相结合. 关于合成复合降解和现实世界多任务基准的实验显示,比评估的全一基线和与多型制剂的恢复质量有改进。 PrismRestore通过单一的恢复骨干和比评估的剂基线更快的推论来实现这些结果.

articles.title: ShadowTransfer: A Geographic Transfer Benchmark for Overhead Shadow Detection
articles.content: Overhead aerial imagery feeds dense-prediction pipelines that are routinely trained in one geographic region and deployed in another, yet no benchmark measures how shadow detection models transfer across regions. Existing overhead shadow datasets either lack a geographic transfer protocol or rely on automatically generated labels. We introduce ShadowTransfer, a benchmark of 4,500 human-verified shadow masks across three U.S. cities at two native resolutions, paired with a leave-one-city-out evaluation protocol. Under vanilla training, holding out the test city costs 3.5 to 7.8 mIoU across four architectures, the gap remains significant when the training set grows from 225 to 900 images, and six of eight adaptation methods degrade more than vanilla training on average. We propose a three-probe framework that diagnoses where and how the transfer breaks: the failure operates in feature space, beyond the reach of pixel-histogram matching, shows up as a confidence collapse on shadow pixels while background confidence stays intact, and is recoverable by retraining different architectural components depending on the model: encoder for some, decoder for others. These findings replicate on INRIA building footprints, suggesting they describe geographic transfer beyond shadows. Guided by the diagnosis, we build Spectral Information Bottleneck (SIB), a plug-in module with one component per finding. Across the 9 (architecture, held-out city) cells, SIB has the smallest mean gap to the within-city upper bound of the ten methods we evaluate (6.42 mIoU), level with FDA. The benchmark, LOCO protocol, code, and trained models are released to support reproducible evaluation of geographic transfer in overhead dense prediction.

articles.title_zh: Shadow Transfer:覆盖阴影探测的地理转移基准
articles.content_zh: 地面航空图象为一个地理区域例行训练的、部署在另一个地理区域的密集预测管道提供素材,但没有衡量阴影探测模型如何跨区域转移的基准。 现有的俯冲阴影数据集要么缺乏地理传输协议,要么依赖自动生成的标签. 我们引入了Shadow Transfer(Shadow Transfer),这是美国三个城市的4500个经人验证的影子面具的基准,通过两个本土分辨率,配以一个留守一城评估协议. 在香草培训下,测试城市的费用为3.5至7.8mIoU,涉及四种建筑,如果培训从225个图像增加到900个图像,差距仍然很大,8种适应方法中有6种比香草培训平均降低更多。 我们提出一个诊断传输中断地点和方式的三试框架:失败在像素-视象图匹配所无法达到的特征空间中运行,表现为阴影像素上的置信性崩溃,而背景置信性保持完好无损,并且根据模型再培训不同的建筑构件是可以恢复的:为一些人编码,为其他人解码. 这些发现复制了INRIA建筑脚印,表明它们描述了超越阴影的地域转移. 在诊断的指导下,我们建造了Spectral Information Bottleneck(SIB),一个插件模块,每个发现有一个组件. 在9个(建筑,被扣留的城市)细胞中,SIB与我们评价的十种方法(6.42 mIoU)的市内上界(FDA)的距离最小。 发布了基准、LOCO协议、代码和训练有素的模型,以支持对高密度预测中的地理转移进行可复制的评价。

articles.title: NereidVLA: Learning to Understand and Navigate the Underwater World
articles.content: Underwater navigation requires translating visual spatial cues into motion, yet marine vision-language datasets rarely include paired robot trajectories. We present NereidVLA, a vision-language-action model that transfers marine spatial knowledge to language-conditioned 3D navigation. We first train Sea2Know on approximately two million marine examples to learn target grounding, spatial relations, and scene structure without paired robot-motion supervision. We then adapt it using expert trajectories executed under simulated underwater vehicle dynamics. Given RGB histories and a language instruction, NereidVLA predicts discrete motion tokens that decode into local 3D trajectories for closed-loop tracking. Evaluation combines an independent six-dimensional underwater navigation understanding benchmark with offline prediction and closed-loop navigation. Under matched navigation training and execution settings, marine spatial pretraining increases simulation success from 72.4% to 84.4%. Without fine-tuning on the real test environment, NereidVLA achieves 78.75% success in laboratory-pool robot trials, compared with 47.50% for InternVLA-N1. These results show that marine spatial supervision can support downstream motion learning and physical underwater navigation.

articles.title_zh: NereidVLA:学习理解和导航水下世界
articles.content_zh: 水下导航需要将视觉空间提示转化为运动,然而海洋视觉语言数据集却很少包括配对机器人轨迹. 我们介绍了NereidVLA,一种将海洋空间知识转移到语言条件3D导航的视觉-语言-行动模型。 我们首先训练Sea2 了解大约200万个海洋例子, 学习目标地面,空间关系,和场景结构 没有对机器人-运动监督。 然后我们用在模拟水下飞行器动力学下 执行的专家轨迹来调整它 鉴于RGB历史和一个语言指令,NereidVLA预测解码为本地3D轨迹的离散运动符号,用于闭路跟踪. 评价将独立的六维水下导航理解基准与离线预测和闭路导航相结合。 在相应的导航培训和执行环境下,海洋空间预训将模拟成功率从72.4%提高到84.4%。 如果不对真实的试验环境进行微调,NereidVLA在实验室-池式机器人试验中取得了78.75%的成功,而InternVLA-N1则取得了47.50%的成功. 这些结果显示,海洋空间监督可以支持下游运动学习和物理水下航行.

articles.title: Gaspard: Expressive unified speech and gesture synthesis with continuous autoregressive flow-matching and decoupled classifier-free guidance
articles.content: Human communication involves highly coordinated multimodal signals such as speech and co-speech gestures. Existing approaches for generating both modalities commonly follow a cascaded pipeline, where speech is generated first and subsequently used to drive gesture generation; speech generation is therefore independent of gestures. We introduce Gaspard, a unified speech--gesture generation model based on continuous autoregressive generation with next-step flow-matching predictions, and trained on Seamless Interaction, a large-scale multimodal dataset. The heterogeneous temporal properties of speech and gesture motivate modality-specific prediction heads and decoupled classifier-free guidance over the two generation streams. This guidance rebalances the influence of speech and gesture at inference time, improving expressivity while mitigating dynamics collapse in continuous autoregressive gesture generation. Objective and perceptual evaluations show that Gaspard is a strong gesture generation model against unimodal baselines and that it produces highly synchronous speech and gestures compared to a matched cascaded system.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Gaspard: 表达式统一语音和手势合成,具有连续的自动回流匹配和解耦的无分类器引导.
articles.content_zh: 人类通信涉及高度协调的多式联运信号,如语音和同声信号。 生成这两种模式的现有办法通常采用级联式管道,首先生成语音,然后用于驱动手势生成;因此,语音生成独立于手势。 我们引入了Gaspard,一种基于连续自递式生成的统一的语音-地理生成模型,并附有下一步的流量比对预测,并接受了关于Seamless Interactive,一个大规模多式联运数据集的培训. 语音和手势的不同时间特性激发了特定模式的预测头和在两代流上解开无分类器的引导. 这种指导在推论时间重新平衡了言语和手势的影响,提高了表达性,同时在持续的自递式手势生成中缓解动态崩溃. 客观和洞察评价显示,Gaspard是对照单一模式基线的强势手势生成模式,与相应的级联系统相比,它能产生高度同步的言语和手势。

articles.title: Does the Action Matter? Probing Action-Conditioned Semantic Forecasting as a World Model for Autonomous Driving
articles.content: World models are increasingly used in autonomous driving to predict how a scene evolves under the ego vehicle's actions, supporting counterfactual reasoning and model-based planning. However, existing evaluations focus on prediction fidelity and planning performance, and rarely verify that the predictions depend on the conditioning action. In this paper, we study action dependence in action-conditioned semantic forecasting, which predicts future semantic segmentation from past segmentations and the ego action. We compare a forecaster with feature-wise and input-level action conditioning against an identical model without action input, and measure action dependence with test-time action interventions scored by standard segmentation metrics. The evaluation is validated in a synthetic environment with known action-dependent dynamics and applied to Cityscapes and BDD100K, both within each dataset and across the two vehicle platforms. Experiments show that the executed action improves mid-term mIoU by at most 2.5 points on Cityscapes and 0.6 points on BDD100K, whereas a wrong action reduces it by up to 23.2 and 7.0 points, below the model without action input. On real data, feature-wise conditioning depends 1.6 times more on the action than input-level conditioning at similar accuracy, whereas both depend on it equally in the synthetic environment, where the history does not determine the action. These results show that an accuracy gain indicates that a driving world model uses its action, but not how strongly its forecasts depend on it. Code is available at https://github.com/binayksingh/does-action-matter.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 动作有用吗? 试验行动条件语义预测作为世界自主驾驶模式
articles.content_zh: 世界模型越来越多地用于自主驾驶,用来预测场景如何在自我载体的行动下演化,支持反事实推理和模型化规划. 然而,现有的评价侧重于预测忠诚度和规划业绩,很少核实预测取决于条件行动。 在本文中,我们研究了行动条件语义预测中的动作依赖性,预测了未来语义从过去分解和自我行动中分解出来. 我们对照一个没有行动投入的相同模型,将预测器与特性和输入级的动作条件进行比较,并用标准分解度标分的测试时间动作干预来衡量动作依赖性。 该评价在人工合成环境中进行验证,并具有已知的依赖行动动态,适用于Cityscapes和BDD100K,在每个数据集和两个车辆平台之间。 实验显示,执行的动作在Cityscapes上改进了中期mIoU最多2.5分,在BDD100K上改进了0.6分,而错误的动作却将它降低了高达23.2分和7.0分,低于模型,没有动作输入. 在真实数据上,特征-导调依赖于动作的1.6倍于类似精度的输入级导调,而两者在合成环境中都同样依赖于它,因为历史上并不决定动作. 这些结果显示,精确度的提高表明,驱动世界模型使用其行动,但并不表明其预测对其依赖的程度。 守则可在https://github.com/binayksingh/ does-action-matter上查阅。

articles.title: Synthesizing hyperspectral Data using generative Models to train spectral Unmixing Methods for low-cost Crop Residue Cover Mapping
articles.content: The spectral range of the Field Imaging Nanosatellite for Crop residue Hyperspectral Mapping (FINCH), developed by the University of Toronto Aerospace Team's Space System Division, poses significant challenges for hyperspectral unmixing to determine crop residue cover fractional abundances. The severe lack of standard indices necessitates the use of complex, data-driven unmixing models. Complex unmixing models require dense, well-distributed manifolds, whereas ground-truth datasets are sparse and expensive. To better leverage the information content in existing ground-truth datasets, this study presents a framework that decouples interpolation and abundance-mapping estimation via an intermediary conditional data generator, contrasting with traditional single-model unmixing pipelines. This decoupling enables the inclusion of physical prior knowledge about spectra, which is not natively accessible to unmixing models, thereby artificially expanding the dataset to serve as a Monte Carlo approximation of the population risk. To test this hypothesis, we have proposed two generator models: a 1D Conditional U-Net with Conformer Layers (GD-Streamline) and a Dual-Path Transformer Conditional Variational AutoEncoder (TCVAE), and two unmixing models: Multi-Layered Perceptrons (MLP) and Fourier Neural Operators (FNO). The results of the study indicate a need for rigorous integration and introduction of spectral priors within the scope of the proposed decoupling framework to prevent domain and mode collapse and hallucination by the generator models; otherwise, this leads to falsely approximated data manifolds, ultimately resulting in unsatisfactory and out-of-distribution unmixing performance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 合成超光谱 利用基因模型培训低成本作物残余物覆盖图的光谱解混合方法的数据
articles.content_zh: 多伦多大学航空航天小组空间系统司开发的作物残留超光谱绘图野外成像纳米卫星(FINCH)的光谱范围对超光谱解析以确定作物残留覆盖分数丰度构成重大挑战。 由于严重缺乏标准指数,必须使用复杂、数据驱动的不混合模型。 复杂的不混合模型需要密集、分布良好的多面体,而地面真实数据集则稀少且昂贵。 为了更好地利用现有地面真实数据集中的信息内容,本研究提出了一个框架,通过中间有条件的数据生成器,与传统的单一模式的不混合管道形成对比,使插值和丰度映射估算脱钩。 这种脱钩可以包含关于光谱的先天物理知识,而光谱在本土是无法被解混模型所获取的,从而人为地扩大数据集,作为人口风险的蒙特卡洛近似值. 为了测试这一假说,我们提出了两种生成模型:一种是带有Conformer Layles(GD-Streamline)的1D条件U-Net,一种是双帕变换器条件Variational AutoEncoder(TCVAE),另一种是两种不混合模型:多拉耶雷德受体(MLP)和Fourier神经操作器(FNO). 研究结果表明,需要在拟议的脱钩框架范围内严格整合和引入光谱前科,以防止域和模式崩溃和生成模型产生幻觉;否则,这会导致错误的近似数据复数,最终导致不满意和分散的不混合性能.

articles.title: ReCoCo: From Patches to Compositions for Visual Representation Learning
articles.content: Self-supervised learning has produced powerful visual representations, yet learning strong dense features remains challenging. While consistency between augmented views provides strong image-level supervision, extending this principle to local visual content is less straightforward. Existing approaches often match individual patches across views or identify coherent regions, introducing uncertainties in correspondence estimation and assumptions about how visual content should be grouped. We introduce ReCoCo (Regional Composition Consistency), a principled approach that extends cross-view consistency to the regional level without requiring such correspondences or semantic grouping. ReCoCo represents the content shared between augmented views through compositions of their patch-level predictions over learned visual prototypes. By aligning these compositions, the model learns from regions containing multiple visual concepts without requiring them to be separated beforehand. ReCoCo integrates naturally with teacher-student self-distillation and introduces no additional learned parameters. Extensive experiments demonstrate substantial improvements in frozen-feature segmentation, clustering, and regional retrieval while maintaining competitive image-level recognition, alleviating the trade-off between dense and global representation quality.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ReCoCo: 从补丁到视觉代表性学习的构成
articles.content_zh: 自我监督的学习产生了强大的视觉表现,然而学习强烈的密集特征仍然具有挑战性. 虽然增强观点之间的一致性提供了强有力的图像层面的监督,但将这一原则推广到当地视觉内容并不那么直接。 现有方法往往与各种观点相匹配,或确定一致的区域,从而在函证估计和关于视觉内容应如何分组的假设方面产生不确定性。 我们采用了ReCoCo(区域构成一致性),这是一种原则性做法,将交叉观点的连贯性扩大到区域一级,而不需要这种对应或语义分类。 ReCoCo代表了通过补丁水平预测对所学视觉原型的构成而增加的视图之间共享的内容. 通过调整这些组成,模型从包含多种视觉概念的区域学习,而不需要事先将它们分开. ReCoCo自然与师生自我消化融合,不引入额外的学习参数. 广泛的实验表明,在保持具有竞争力的图像水平识别的同时,在冷冻地貌分化、集聚和区域检索方面有重大改进,减轻了稠密与全球代表性质量之间的权衡。

articles.title: Edge-Efficient Joint RAW Image Compression and Restoration for Smart Wearable Devices
articles.content: Smart wearable devices, such as augmented reality glasses, increasingly rely on cameras to understand and interact with their surroundings. However, their compact sensors often capture noisy RAW images, while limited compute and power make high-quality on-device restoration difficult. This creates an emerging need to reduce both local computation and transmission cost without sacrificing image quality. Two common solutions are to offload restoration or to compress the raw data before transmission. The first makes RAW transmission costly; the second reduces the payload but can spend bitrate preserving sensor noise. We address this fundamental mismatch with an asymmetric framework for joint RAW compression and restoration that directly optimizes the transmitted representation for clean image reconstruction. A lightweight on-device encoder compresses noisy RAW measurements into a bitstream, while a higher-capacity backend decoder jointly denoises and demosaics the encoded representation. We use knowledge distillation to train a smaller encoder for tighter compute budgets. Experiments on real and synthetic data show improved rate-restoration performance over strong cascaded compression-restoration pipelines and learned compression baselines. On SIDD, our method improves PSNR by more than 1.5 dB over cascaded baselines at approximately 0.25 bits per pixel. We further validate the method on real 12 MP RAW images captured with commercial smart glasses and measure sender-side latency on both smartphone and smart-glasses hardware. The distilled encoder achieves a 27.6$\times$ NPU inference speedup over on-device NAFNet for 256$\times$256 output patches. The code is available at https://github.com/coolsyn2000/CRAW
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 智能可穿戴设备的边缘有效联合RAW图像压缩和修复
articles.content_zh: 智能的可穿戴设备,如增强现实眼镜,越来越依赖摄像机来理解和与周围环境互动. 然而,其紧凑的传感器往往能捕捉吵闹的RAW图像,而有限的计算和功率使得高品质的机载设备修复变得困难. 这就产生了在不牺牲图像质量的情况下降低本地计算和传输成本的新需要。 两种常见的解决方案是卸载恢复,或在传输前压缩原始数据. 第一种方法使RAW传输成本高;第二种方法减少有效载荷,但可以花费比特率保存传感器噪音。 我们用一个非对称的框架来解决这种根本性的不匹配,即联合RAW压缩和恢复,直接优化传输的图像重建表现。 轻量级的装订编码器将噪音的RAW测量压缩成位流,而功率较高的后端解码器将编码的表示法联合凹陷并演示出来. 我们用知识蒸馏来训练一个更小的编码器来进行更严格的计算预算. 关于真实和合成数据的实验显示,相对于强大的级联压缩-恢复管道和所学的压缩基线,速率恢复性能有所改善。 在SIDD上,我们的方法将PSNR改进了超过1.5 dB的级联基线,每像素约0.25比特. 我们进一步验证使用商业智能眼镜捕获的12 MP RAW真实图像上的方法,并在智能手机和智能眼镜硬件上测量发送方的潜伏度. 蒸馏编码器实现27.6美元\times$ NPU推导速度在device NAFNet上,以256美元\times$256输出补丁. 该守则可在https://github.com/coolsyn2000/CRAW上查阅。

articles.title: Ultimate3D: Teaching Multimodal LLMs 3D Camera-Object Relations by Large-Scale Visual Instruction Data
articles.content: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) struggle with accurately capturing camera-object relations, especially for object orientation, camera viewpoint, and camera shots. This stems from the fact that existing MLLMs are trained on images with limited diverse camera-object relations and corresponding textual descriptions. To address this, we propose a synthetic generation pipeline to create large-scale 3D visual instruction datasets. Our framework takes 3D assets as input and uses rendering and diffusion-based image generation models to create photorealistic images preserving precise camera-object relations. Additionally, large language models (LLMs) are used to generate text prompts for guiding visual instruction tuning and controlling image generation. We create Ultimate3D, a large-scale 3D-grounded 2D visual instruction dataset. Ultimate3D consists of 240K VQAs with precise camera-object annotations, and corresponding benchmark. MLLMs fine-tuned on our proposed dataset outperform commercial models by a large margin, achieving an average accuracy improvement of 29.7% on camera-object relation recognition tasks. Our code, dataset, and benchmark will contribute to broad MLLM applications.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Ultimate3D: 由大型视觉指令数据教学多模式 LLMS 3D相机-对象关系
articles.content_zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)在准确捕捉相机-对象关系上挣扎着,特别是针对对象方向,相机视角,和相机镜头. 这是因为现有的MLLMs在图像上受到训练,相机-对象关系有限,文字描述相应. 为了解决这个问题,我们提出一个合成生成管道来创建大型的3D视觉指令数据集. 我们的框架以3D资产作为输入,并使用渲染和传播的图像生成模型来创建摄影现实主义的图像,保存精确的相机-对象关系. 此外,大型语言模型(LLMS)被用来生成文字提示,指导视觉指示调制和控制图像生成. 我们创建了Ultimate3D,一个大型的3D基底2D视觉指令数据集. Ultimate3D由240K VQA组成,带有精确的相机对象说明,以及相应的基准. MLLMs对我们提出的数据集进行了微调,大大超过了商业模型,使相机-对象关系识别任务的平均精度提高了29.7%。 我们的代码、数据集和基准将有助于广泛的MLLM应用。

articles.title: The Elephant in the Question: Unified Models Picture the Concepts Behind Their Answers
articles.content: Visualizing intermediate representations could help us inspect the reasoning steps underlying a model output. Unified multimodal models offer this opportunity by combining understanding and generation in one architecture. Their image generators can access representations formed while processing text. We introduce the V-lens, which uses this connection to visualize a chosen token's hidden state without training a decoder. Across four diffusion-based and two purely autoregressive unified models, the resulting images reveal key intermediate concepts that connect a question to its answer even when the concepts are never named explicitly. Controlled tests show how this content changes with context, token position, and depth. We then introduce lens tuning, which supervises selected hidden states with pictures through the V-lens. Across BAGEL, SenseNova-U1, and HunyuanImage-3.0, the rate of correct visualizations of pronoun referents rises from 2-11% to 86-94%. Surprisingly, such visual supervision also improves text answers without supervising the answer tokens directly. Code is available at https://github.com/multimodal-ai-lab/V-lens.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 问题中的大象:统一模型 描绘其答案背后的概念
articles.content_zh: 可视化的中间表示可以帮助我们检查模型输出背后的推理步骤。 统一的多式联运模式通过将理解和生成结合起来,提供了一个机会。 他们的图像生成器可以访问处理文本时形成的表达式. 我们介绍V -Lens, 它利用这个连接 直观一个选择的 代号的隐藏状态 不训练解码器。 在整个四个基于扩散的模型和两个纯粹自递性的统一模型中,所产生的图像揭示出关键的中间概念,这些中间概念将一个问题与其答案联系起来,即使这些概念从未被明确命名。 受控测试显示此内容如何随上下文,符号位置,深度变化. 然后我们引入镜头调制,通过V-Lens来监督选定的隐藏状态. 横跨BAGEL,SenseNova-U1和Hunyuanimage-3.0,代名词的正确可视化率从2-11%上升到86-94%. 令人惊讶的是,这种视觉监督也改进了文本答案,而没有直接监督答案符号. 代码见https://github.com/multimate-ai-lab/V-lens。

articles.title: Training-free motion statistics match self-supervised behavior encoders
articles.content: Self-supervised encoders for animal behavior are often trained on, or fed, hand-built movement features. We ask whether they beat those ingredients when compared fairly. A training-free representation, made of generic per-frame measurements summarized over fixed time windows and reduced with PCA, is compared with retrained and released encoders (BAMS, hBehaveMAE) under a preregistered protocol: frozen representations of equal size and one shared classifier. On CalMS21 it reaches 85.8 macro F1 against 82.4 for the best encoder, ties with four labelled videos, and leads when the annotator changes or new behaviors must be learned from a few videos; the reading holds for encoders retrained with three seeds. On the MABe22 mouse triplets it scores 83.7 against 80.3 for the released hBehaveMAE (gap +3.4, 95% interval +2.1 to +4.7). On a second species, the MABe22 fly groups, the same recipe scores 51.6 mean F1 over 50 tasks against 48.2 for BAMS, the best published method. On Shot7M2, the synthetic basketball benchmark built by hBehaveMAE's authors, it scores 68.8 against 64.7 for hBehaveMAE, the best method in that paper, though hBehaveMAE remains better on the shortest movements. Short time windows carry most of the result. Raw keypoints in each body's own frame, summarized over the same windows, already match or beat the encoders on both mouse datasets and on Shot7M2; on the fly groups they fall short, and the measurements add 5.3 points. On these benchmarks, current behavior encoders have yet to beat the hand-built features they learn from, and such baselines should be reported alongside them.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 训练自由运动统计匹配自我监督的行为编码器
articles.content_zh: 自我监督的动物行为编码器经常在手建动作特征上接受训练或喂食. 我们问他们是否公平比较了这些成分。 在预先登记的协议下,与重新培训和释放的编码器(BAMS, hBEhaveMAE)相比,采用在固定时间窗口中汇总的、与五氯苯甲醚相比减少的通用每帧计量法制作的免费培训表述:同大小的冻结表述和一个共享的分类器。 在CalMS21上,它达到85.8宏F1对82.4对最佳编码器,与4个标注的视频连接,当注释器改变或新行为必须从几段视频中得知时,线索;对编码器的读取控制用3个种子重新训练. 在 MABE22 鼠标三进制中,它对于释放的 hBehaveMAE(gap +3.4,95%的间隔+2.1到+4.7)的比分为83.7比80.3. 在第二个物种上,MABE22的蝇类组,同样的食谱评分51.6比50任务中的F1比48.2,BAMS是最佳公布的方法. 在Shot7M2上,HBEhaveMAE的作者们构建的合成篮球基准对hBEhaveMAE的成绩为68.8比64.7,这是该论文中最好的方法,不过hBEhaveMAE在最短的移动上仍然较好. 时间短的窗口承载了大部分结果. 每个机体自身框架的原始键点,在同一个窗口上总结,已经在鼠标数据集和Shot7M2上匹配或击败编码器;在苍蝇组上它们落差,测量结果增加了5.3分. 在这些基准上,目前的行为编码器还没有比起他们从中学习的手建的特性,应该同时报告这种基线。

articles.title: Read Together, Answer Apart: How Earlier Questions Help Vision-Language Models Look
articles.content: Vision-language models (VLMs) are often asked several questions about the same image in a single prompt (co-asking), yet existing evaluations report conflicting accuracy gains and hallucinations at the prompt level without tracking how individual answers change. By pairing each question's single-question and co-asked answers across 22 open-weight VLMs (1B-35B), we find that erratic net shifts reflect two opposing effects: on Densely Captioned Images (DCI), every model repairs 15.4%-29.8% of its single-question errors under co-asking, while the share of correct answers turned wrong falls from 30.8% on weaker models to 4.7% on stronger ones. Across all 14 models supporting custom attention masks, we show through attention readouts and layer-window interventions that earlier same-image questions read visual information into their question tokens in the early-to-middle layers during prefill, helping later questions concentrate image attention onto their queried targets. This visual help accumulates across the scene even across non-overlapping regions, whereas blocking earlier questions from attending to the image lowers both target localization and accuracy in all 14 models. While cross-question help is established during shared question reading, part of the co-asking damage enters later during answer decoding when the decoder attends to other question stems. We therefore introduce Read Together, Answer Apart, a training-free decoding mask that keeps shared prefill intact and isolates each answer from other stems, improving co-asking accuracy on 12 of 14 models on DCI (up to +4.71 percentage points, closing 70% of the pooled gap to asking alone) and on 10, 8, and 5 of the 14 models on WebUI, FinTabNet, and GQA (up to +11.4, +5.3, and +1.1 points).
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 共同阅读,Answer Apart:较早的问题如何帮助视觉-语言模型外观
articles.content_zh: 愿景语言模型(VLMs)常常在一个单一的即时(共同任务)中被问及关于同一图像的几个问题,然而,现有的评价却报告在即时的准确性增益和幻觉存在冲突,而没有跟踪单个答案的变化. 通过将每个题的单题和共同询问的答案对齐到22个开放量的VLM(1B-35B),我们发现无常的网格移动反映了两种相反的效果:在感知性悬浮图像(DCI)上,每个模型在共同询问下修复其单题错误的15.4%-29.8%,而正确答案的比例从弱模型的30.8%下降到强模型的4.7%. 在14个支持自定义关注面罩的模型中, 我们通过注意读取和层窗干预, 显示早期的同位素问题在预填时将视觉信息读入他们早期到中层的问题符号, 这种视觉帮助在整个场景中累积,甚至跨越非重叠区域,而阻碍早些时候的对图像的处理问题则降低了所有14种模型中的目标定位和准确性。 虽然交叉问题帮助是在共同的问题阅读中确立的,但当解码器处理其他问题时,部分共同请求的损害在回答解码时进入后期. 因此,我们引入了Read Conference, Assolute,一种免费的解码面具,保持共享预填完整,并将每个答案从其他答案中分离出来,提高了DCI的14个模型中的12个(最高+4.71个百分点,将集合缺口的70%关闭单独询问)和WebUI、FinTabNet和GQA的14个模型中的10、8和5个(最高+11.4、+5.3和+1.1分)的共同查询精度。

articles.title: Counterfactual World Models: JEPAs That Reason About "What If"
articles.content: World models operate in a world they cannot fully observe. When a hidden disturbance, such as a current pushing a boat, changes the outcome of an action, a counterfactual question follows: what would have happened under a different action, subject to the same disturbance? Its answer separates bad decisions from bad luck. We prove that world models trained on factual transitions cannot answer it on their own, whatever their data or capacity. For many physical systems, the observed outcome and a simple property of the dynamics suffice: natura non facit saltus, nature makes no leaps. When actions and disturbances act as separate forces, their interaction is second-order in time, so the counterfactual outcome is, to first order, the observed outcome plus the difference between the world model's predictions under the alternative and factual actions. This yields a counterfactual world model with no counterfactual data, extra parameters, or retraining. For transitions of duration $h$, we prove an $O(h^2)$ bound on the counterfactual error relative to the disturbance variance, establish a matching minimax lower bound from unpaired factual data, and characterize failures at discontinuities, coordinate folds, and disturbances that scale the command. We validate these predictions from pixels with JEPA world models on frozen DINOv2 and masked autoencoder (MAE) encoders. On four rendered simulators, our approach improves counterfactual $R^2$ from $38$--$46\%$ to $86$--$96\%$ with the same world models; on a fifth, an underwater vehicle, it reaches $90$--$94\%$ with sixteen times more factual data. Four further frozen encoders, DINOv3, SigLIP~2, CLIP and EVA-02, give $81$--$95\%$ on the same simulators. In hindsight planning, it finds the action that would have reached the goal in $35$--$69\%$ of events, against $14$--$23\%$ for an oracle planner that knows the simulator but not the outcome.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 反事实世界模型: JEPAs 关于"如果"的理由
articles.content_zh: 世界模式在一个无法充分观察的世界运作。 当一个隐藏的扰动,如水流推船,改变一个动作的结果时,一个反事实问题如下:在不同的动作下会发生什么,受到同样的扰动? 它的答案将坏的决定和坏运气区分开来. 我们证明,接受过事实转变培训的世界模型,无论数据或能力如何,都无法自行应对。 对于许多物理系统来说,观测到的结果和动力学的简单属性就足够了:natura非富含盐,自然不会跳跃. 当动作和扰动作为单独的力量时,它们的相互作用是时间上的第二顺序,所以反事实结果,第一顺序是观测到的结果加上世界模型在另类行动和事实行动下的预测的区别. 这产生了一个反事实世界模型,没有反事实数据,额外参数,也没有再培训. 对于持续时间($h)的过渡,我们证明一个$O(h^2)美元绑定在与扰动差异相对的反事实错误上,从未经证实的事实数据中建立一个匹配的最小值下绑定,并描述不连续时的故障,坐标折叠,以及能够放大命令的扰动。 我们用JEPA的世界模型验证这些像素在冷冻的DINOv2和蒙面自动编码器(MAE)编码器上的预测. 在四个模拟器上,我们的方法使反事实的美元从38美元-46美元提高到86美元-96美元-同一种世界模型;第五个是水下飞行器,它达到90美元-94美元-比16倍的事实数据。 4个进一步的冻结编码器,DINov3,SigLIP~2,CLIP和EVA-02,在同一模拟器上给予81美元-95美元-. 在事后规划中,它发现本来可以达到目标的行动是35美元-69美元-事件,而对于一个知道模拟器但不知道结果的先知规划者来说,行动是14美元-23美元。

articles.title: 4D-TEMPO: Differentiable 4D-STEM ptychography via fast Physics Optimizers
articles.content: Electron ptychography recovers atomic structure from 4D-STEM data: diffraction patterns at multiple positions of a scanned probe. Current codes reconstruct an image and read atoms off it, or fit atoms under an $L_1$ loss; neither gives per-atom uncertainty. We propose 4D-TEMPO, a differentiable physical renderer that fits the atoms, the microscope, and the detector directly to the recorded electron counts under a Poisson likelihood. The output is a list of atoms, each a Gaussian primitive with a 3D position, a thermal width, and a model-conditional error bar from the Fisher information. The Fisher information also conditions the solver, gives the dose (electrons per Å$^2$) each parameter needs, and separates calibration from imaging. On a simulated WSe$_2$ bilayer, starting from the published reconstruction, fitted atoms cut in-plane error by a third (3.2 vs. 4.8 pm) and depth error by 40-61% against its 3D peaks. Depth comes from multiple scattering into the dark field, the faint counts outside the direct beam. The two layers, $10\times$ closer than the depth of field, separate; per-atom depth then follows the layer geometry. When the model is well specified, the bars are calibrated (69% of position coordinates within $1σ$). On experimental WSe$_2$, fitted atoms predict held-out patterns better than the three published codes we test. With free probe modes where atoms are incomplete, the same likelihood predicts best on all three held-out benchmarks, matches every WSe$_2$ baseline in 5 min against up to 20.5 h, and passes torchslice at its released setting 180$\times$ sooner on PrScO$_3$. Per-atom error bars, planned doses, and fast reconstruction point to low-dose, real-time 3D imaging of beam-sensitive and dynamic materials.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 4D-TEMPO:通过快速物理优化器可区分的 4D-STEM 造型
articles.content_zh: 电平面图从4D-STEM数据中恢复原子结构:扫描探测器在多个位置的疏松模式. 当前代码重建一个图像并读取其上的原子,或者将原子置于$L_1美元的损失之下;既不给出每个原子的不确定性. 我们提出4D-TEMPO,一种与原子,显微镜,探测器相适应的异质物理渲染器,在波森概率下直接与所记录的电子计数相对应. 输出是原子列表,每个原子都有一个高斯原始,具有3D位置,热宽度,以及来自费舍尔信息的模型条件错误条. 费舍尔信息还给求解器提供了条件,给出了每个参数需要的剂量(每美元2美元),并将校准与成像区分开来. 在模拟的WSe$_2美元双层机上,从公布的重建开始,安装的原子在飞机中被剪除三分之一(3.2对4.8pm),深度误差在3D峰值上为40-61%. 深度来自多次散射到暗场,昏暗的计数在直梁外. 两层,10\times$比球场深度更近,分开;每原子深度随地层几何. 当模型被明确指定时,栏杆会被校准(69%的位置坐标在1美元/3美元之内). 在实验性的WSe$_2美元上,安装的原子预测被搁置的模式比我们测试的三种公布代码要好. 在原子不完全的自由探测模式下,同样的可能性对所有三个搁置基准最能预测,在5分钟内将每个WSe美元_2美元的基准值与20.5小时的比对,并在释放时通过火炬,将180美元\时间更早地设定在PrScOO$_3美元上。 每原子误差条,计划剂量,以及快速重建指向低剂量,实时的光束敏感和动态材料立体成像.

articles.title: A$^3$Bench: Compositional Reasoning over Aggressive Interactions in Videos
articles.content: Recent Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved strong performance on general video understanding benchmarks, yet their ability to reason about participant roles in aggressive interactions remains largely unexplored. Existing violence and crime datasets primarily evaluate whether aggression occurs, without testing whether models can identify who performed the action, who received it, and how participants are related within the scene. To address this gap, we introduce A$^3$Bench, a benchmark to study aggressive action and association in videos. The benchmark evaluates whether models can jointly recognize aggressive actions, distinguish aggressors from victims and bystanders, and correctly bind actions to participants under challenging distractor settings. We benchmark 17 multimodal models and find that they struggle substantially on fine-grained aggressive-scene understanding. Performance degrades consistently as reasoning complexity increases, with models frequently confusing aggressors with victims or bystanders, revealing a systematic failure in role-action association rather than coarse aggression recognition alone. We further observe that increasing model scale or generic reasoning models experience limited improvement. Finally, we explore a simple role-graph prompting strategy that encourages structured reasoning over participant interactions, leading to improvements in compositional reasoning. Our findings highlight that reliable aggressive-scene understanding remains a major challenge for current MLLMs and motivate future research on role-aware video reasoning beyond coarse violence detection. Code and dataset: https://github.com/austincbaker/A3Bench.

articles.title_zh: A$^3 Bench: 视频中侵略性互动的构成理由
articles.content_zh: 近期的多式联运大型语言模型在一般视频理解基准上取得了强劲的性能,然而,它们就参与者在积极互动中的作用提出理由的能力仍然基本上没有得到探讨。 现有的暴力和犯罪数据集主要评价是否发生侵略,而没有检验模型是否能够确定实施行动的人、接受行动的人以及参与者在现场内部的关系。 为了弥补这一差距,我们采用了A^3 Bench,这是研究侵略行动和视频中的关联的基准。 该基准评价模型是否能够共同识别侵略行动,将侵略者与受害者和旁观者区别开来,并在具有挑战性的分散注意力环境下将行动正确约束给参与者。 我们以17种多式联运模式为基准,发现它们在精细的侵略性理解上挣扎。 随着推理复杂性的提高,性能持续下降,模式往往将攻击者与受害者或旁观者混为一谈,暴露出角色行动联系的系统性失败,而不仅仅是粗糙的侵略承认。 我们进一步注意到,模型规模或通用推理模型不断增长,但改进有限。 最后,我们探索一种简单的角色图激励战略,鼓励对参与者互动进行结构化推理,从而改进组成推理。 我们的调查结果强调,可靠的正面理解仍然是当前MLLM的一大挑战,并激励今后在粗糙的暴力探测之外,对角色意识视频推理进行研究。 代码和数据集:https://github.com/austincbaker/A3 Bench.

articles.title: Jeveration: System One Models Now Generate
articles.content: System One models such as Jev return decisions through fast, parallel prediction. In this paper, we introduce Jeveration, showing that the same decision paradigm can also generate high-quality images in a single forward pass. Jeveration builds on a frozen vision-language model, repurposing its visual-semantic knowledge for holistic image generation. The key challenge is to maintain global consistency. A single prompt admits many valid images, yet parallel predictions must converge on a coherent whole. We therefore condition all positions on a shared random state to coordinate parallel predictions, so that each draw yields a different but coherent image. Since the model tends to ignore this state under direct image supervision, we first learn a distribution over discrete image codes to guide single-pass generation. Beyond text-to-image generation, we further unify image-to-image generation and dense prediction within the same architecture, so that one checkpoint supports all three tasks, each in one forward pass. Experiments show that Jeveration generates a 512x512 image in 78 ms, up to 122x faster than existing unified models, while maintaining competitive image quality and dense prediction performance.

articles.title_zh: 热化:系统一个模型现在生成
articles.content_zh: 系统 一个模型,如Jev通过快速,平行的预测返回决定. 在本文中,我们介绍了Jeveration,表明同样的决定范式也可以在一次前传中产生高质量的图像. 耶稣会以冷冻的视觉语言模式为基础,重新运用其视觉语义知识来全面生成图像. 主要挑战是保持全球一致性。 单一的提示承认了许多有效的图像,但并行的预测必须一致地形成一个连贯的整体. 因此,我们把所有立场都建立在共同的随机状态上,以协调平行的预测,这样每一幅图都会产生不同但一致的形象。 由于模型倾向于在直接的图像监督下忽略这种状态,我们首先在离散的图像代码上学习分布,以引导单传生成. 除了文本到图像生成之外,我们进一步将图像到图像生成和密集的预测统一在同一架构内,这样,一个检查点就能支持所有三项任务,每个任务都通过一个前传. 实验显示,Jeveration在78ms中生成512x512图像,最高速度比现有的统一模型快122x,同时保持有竞争力的图像质量和密集的预测性能.

articles.title: HandWorldBench: A Unified Benchmark for Hand-Centric World Models
articles.content: Recent advances in world models are opening new possibilities for fine-grained embodied tasks, with hand-object interaction offering a particularly demanding setting. Modeling these interactions involves capturing how hand actions change objects and how the resulting states persist over time. Yet systematic evaluation tailored to these hand-centric capabilities remains underdeveloped. To address this gap, we introduce HandWorldBench, a unified benchmark that systematically evaluates hand-centric world models across human hands, simulated dexterous hands, and real dexterous hands along six dimensions: visual quality, hand fidelity, appearance consistency, instruction following, physical consistency, and temporal coherence. To construct the benchmark, we develop a data curation pipeline that extracts hand-object interaction clips and screens them for quality, yielding 20,500 high-quality egocentric clips from over 600 hours of footage. We then manually select 500 clips covering seven task families for evaluation. Benchmarking eleven models under a unified protocol reveals that stronger hand-pose control does not consistently translate into coherent object-state evolution and persistence or robust cross-embodiment performance, with several specialized hand-control models underperforming general-purpose text/image-to-video generators on dexterous-hand tasks.

articles.title_zh: 手艺世界 教席:手工业世界模式的统一基准
articles.content_zh: 世界模式最近的进展为精心设计的任务开辟了新的可能,手物交互提供了特别苛刻的环境。 模拟这些相互作用涉及掌握手动如何改变物体,以及由此产生的状态如何长期存在。 然而,针对这些以手为中心的能力进行的系统评价仍然不足。 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了HandWorld Bench这个统一的基准,它系统地评价了整个人类手掌的手心世界模型,模拟了柔软的手掌,以及真实的柔软的手掌,沿着六个维度:视觉质量,手心忠诚,外观一致性,跟随指令,物理一致性,以及时间一致性. 为了构建基准,我们开发了一个数据解析管道,提取手目标交互剪辑并进行质量筛选,从600多小时的镜头中产生20,500个高质量的自我中心剪辑. 然后我们手动挑选500个短片,涉及七个任务领域,以供评估。 对统一协议下的11个模型进行基准分析表明,加强手提式控制并非始终如一地转化为一致的物体状态演化和持久性或强健的交叉化性能,若干专业的手提式控制模型表现不佳的通用文本/图像到视频生成器执行非曲直的手提式任务.

articles.title: Generalization of Text Line Segmentation for HTR in Historical Documents
articles.content: In this paper we investigate the generalization capability of state-of-the-art object detection models (Hi-SAM, YOLO, and RT-DETR) for the automatic segmentation of text lines in historical documents. Generalization is needed because it is not practical for museums and archives to produce large amounts of labeled samples for each new collection. We also evaluate the few-shot setting by fine-tuning the networks with only a small number of training samples per target dataset. To this end, we use nine different datasets that differ significantly in visual layout and language. Additionally, we discuss why mean average precision (mAP), a classic evaluation metric for object detection, is insufficient for assessing the quality of a text line segmentation model. Depending on the dataset, our CRNN models achieve character error rates (CER) ranging from 2.48% to 7.07% per page for the segmented text lines. This is sufficient for reading comprehension and simple text searches. Finally, we quantify the resource and time requirements of training and inference in different use case settings. This forms the basis for more informed decisions about model and hardware choices based on available resources.

articles.title_zh: 将历史文档中 HTR 的文本行分割化
articles.content_zh: 在本文中,我们调查了最先进的物体探测模型(Hi-SAM,YOLO,和RT-DETR)在历史文件中自动分割文本行的通用能力. 需要普遍化,因为博物馆和档案馆为每件新收藏品制作大量标签标本是不切实际的. 我们还通过微调每个目标数据集只有少量培训样本的网络,来评估几弹设定。 为此,我们使用了9个不同的数据集,在视觉布局和语言上差异很大. 此外,我们讨论了为什么平均精度(mAP)这个用于检测物体的经典评价指标不足以评估文本行分区模型的质量。 根据数据集的不同,我们的CRNN模型实现了字符错误率(CER),从2.48%到7.07%的每页分行文本. 这足以读取理解和简单的文本搜索。 最后,我们量化了不同使用情况下培训和推断的资源和时间要求。 这构成了根据现有资源就模型和硬件选择作出更知情决定的基础。

articles.title: Multi-Band Galaxy Novel-View Synthesis with Radiative Gaussian Fields
articles.content: We propose a novel view synthesis tool for galaxies based on Gaussian Splatting (GS). Unlike RGB data, where GS has achieved success, galaxy observations consist of multi-band signals from a massive number of bodies, contain complex patterns of cross-band interactions, and capture light propagation in highly heterogeneous media. As a result, the underlying physical process poses great challenges in model representation and optimization, which have not been investigated in existing research. To this end, we propose a physically inspired Gaussian Splatting method, GalaxyGS, which is equipped with physically meaningful components that capture both the energy emission mechanism of different astronomical bodies and the light propagation between them. In the absence of directly comparable baseline methods, we adopt a wide range of possible alternative approaches. Comparisons conclusively demonstrate that GalaxyGS is better in accuracy and physical fidelity across datasets and metrics.

articles.title_zh: 多班银河小说-维尤合成与辐射型高斯球场
articles.content_zh: 我们提出一个基于高斯白板(GS)的星系新颖的视图合成工具. 与GS已经取得成功的RGB数据不同,银河系观测由来自众多天体的多波段信号组成,包含复杂的跨波段相互作用模式,并在高度多样化的介质中捕捉光传播. 因此,基本的物理过程对模型的表达和优化提出了巨大的挑战,而在现有的研究中还没有对此进行调查. 为此,我们提出一种具有物理灵感的高斯电镀法GalaxyGS,它配备了物理上有意义的组件,既能捕捉不同天文体的能量排放机制,又能捕捉它们之间的光传播. 在没有可直接比较的基准方法的情况下,我们采取了一系列可能的替代办法。 比较最终表明,GalaxyGS在准确性和物理上对数据集和衡量标准更加忠实。

articles.title: DRIFT: Detachable Reasoning for Runtime-Flexible and Efficient End-to-End Driving
articles.content: The integration of vision-language models (VLMs) into end-to-end (E2E) autonomous driving has demonstrated strong potential by providing scene description and reasoning capabilities. However, VLMs are computationally expensive, and switching language reasoning on and off at runtime without hurting closed-loop performance has not been demonstrated, which hinders practical adoption. To address these issues, we propose DRIFT, an E2E autonomous driving framework that integrates a lightweight language model (LM) for visual question answering and action commentary. By efficiently projecting intermediate driving representations into the language embedding space, we demonstrate that a compact LM (<150M parameters) can achieve strong scene description and action commentary. Furthermore, we introduce a runtime-flexible planning module that is trained on surrogate reasoning features distilled from the LM and can be conditioned on either the LM or the surrogate reasoning features at inference. This design enables bypassing the LM entirely when required by deployment constraints, without sacrificing driving performance. With only 255M parameters, DRIFT reaches up to a Driving Score (DS) of 97.03 and a Success Rate of 89.39% (mean over three runs) on Bench2Drive by interleaving its LM and surrogate reasoning at a chosen reasoning rate. This is on par with the strongest non-language models while being far more compact than existing VLM-based models. DRIFT further achieves competitive results on the real-world NAVSIM and AlpaSim benchmarks at significantly lower computational cost than existing VLM-based approaches. Project page: https://drift-e2e.github.io/

articles.title_zh: DRIFT:运行时间灵活高效端对端驱动的可分离理由
articles.content_zh: 通过提供场景描述和推理能力,将视觉语言模型(VLMs)整合到端对端(E2E)自主驱动中,展现了强大的潜力. 然而,VLM在计算上成本很高,运行时切换语言推理而不会伤害闭路性能,这阻碍了实际的采用. 为了解决这些问题,我们提议DRIFT,一个E2E自主驱动框架,将轻量级语言模型(LM)用于视觉问答和动作评论. 通过高效地将中间驱动表示投射到语言嵌入空间中,我们证明一个紧凑的LM(<150M参数)可以实现强烈的场景描述和行动评论. 此外,我们引入了一个运行时间灵活的规划模块,该模块对从LM中提炼出来的替代推理特征进行了培训,并且可以在推断时以LM或替代推理特征为条件。 这种设计能够在部署限制需要时完全绕过LM,而不牺牲驾驶性能. DRIFT只有255M参数,在Bench2Drive上,通过将LM和代理推理按选定的推理率进行互调,达到97.03的驱动分数和89.39%(平均超过3次)的成功率。 这与最强的非语言模型相同,但远比基于VLM的现有模型更为紧凑。 DRIFT进一步在现实世界的NAVSIM和AlpaSim基准上以大大低于现有基于VLM的方法的计算成本实现竞争结果. 项目网页:https://drift-e2e.github.io/

articles.title: Can Omni-modal LLMs Understand Spoken Intentions?
articles.content: Omni-modal large language models (omni-modal LLMs) can respond to spoken requests directly through voice and video calls. Such requests rely on the scene shared by the user and the assistant, so the same utterance may call for different help or for no response. Most audio-visual benchmarks provide questions as separate text input, and interactive benchmarks mostly score a response as a whole. It thus remains unclear whether a model recognizes when the user is asking for help, and whether its reply meets the user's need once the request is recognized. We propose O-IN-Bench to evaluate how well omni-modal LLMs understand spoken intentions. A model watches a complete video with native speech and outputs one text response, or [SILENCE] when no response is needed. O-IN-Bench contains 1,000 Chinese and English samples in five categories and 16 subcategories. Contrastive pairs combine the same request with different scene conditions to test whether the response changes with the context. A sample-specific rubric judges language, intent, and content separately, and O-IN-Engine verifies each rubric against the video. Across 30 omni-modal model configurations, the best overall score is 59.6, achieved by Gemini3.7-Flash. Gemini3.7-Flash passes 74.4% of the intent judgments but only 42.6% of the content judgments. When the speech is a conversation between peers rather than a request to the assistant, even strong models often keep responding. When a reply must satisfy several people, the best score is only 25.9. These results indicate that recognizing a request and meeting its requirements are separate abilities, and O-IN-Bench measures each of them.

articles.title_zh: Omni-module LLMs 能理解语意吗?
articles.content_zh: Omni-module大型语言模型(omni-module LLMs)可以直接通过语音和视频通话响应口头请求. 此类请求依赖于用户和助手共享的场景,因此同样的语句可能要求不同的帮助或无回应. 大多数视听基准将问题作为单独的文本投入,互动基准大多是整个答复。 因此,尚不清楚一个模型是否承认用户何时要求帮助,以及一旦请求得到承认,其答复是否满足用户的需要。 我们建议O-IN-Bench 评估所有模式的LLMs对口语意向的理解程度。 一个模型观看一个完整的视频,里面有本地的语音,并输出一个文本响应,或者当不需要回应时的[静 . O-IN-Bench包含1000个中英文样本,分为5类和16个亚类. 对比对将相同的请求和不同的场景条件结合起来,以测试反应是否随上下文而变化. O-IN-Engine根据视频对每个标题进行验证。 跨30个全米模式模型配置,最佳整体得分59.6分,由双米尼3.7-Flash实现. 双子座3.7-Flash通过74.4%的意向判断,但只有42.6%的内容判断. 当演讲是同行之间的对话而不是对助手的要求时,即使是强健的模型也经常不断响应. 当一个答复必须满足几个人时,最好得分只有25.9分. 这些结果表明,承认一项请求并满足其要求是不同的能力,O-IN-Bench对每个能力进行衡量。

articles.title: Improving Zero-shot 3D Semantic Mapping in Offroad with Geometric Priors
articles.content: Semantic 3D mapping is a powerful representation that enables platform agnostic mobile robot navigation in challenging offroad conditions. Current vision foundation models can accurately predict semantics zero-shot on structured scenes but performance is compromised in natural environments. On the other hand, 3D point clouds encode valuable information for discriminating semantics in scenarios where vision foundation models fail. In this work, we propose fitting a sphericity-elevation distribution for each semantic class to act as geometric anchor. Only the points with the most confident vision foundation model predictions are considered when fitting to produce high quality geometric prior distributions. The geometric prior is fused with the vision foundation model prediction to produce the final semantic mapping. The proposed prior improves SAM3 baseline by +6.3 in mIoU and +8.9 in accuracy on the RELLIS-3D dataset, and by +1.7 in mIoU and +2.1 in accuracy on the WildScenes dataset. The source code will be made public upon paper acceptance.

articles.title_zh: 改进与几何前传的偏僻处的零射三维语义绘图
articles.content_zh: 语义3D映射是一种强大的代表,它能够在挑战越野条件下实现平台不可知的移动机器人导航. 目前的视觉基础模型可以准确预测结构化场景中的语义学零镜头,但在自然环境中性能受损. 另一方面,3D点云为在视觉基础模型失败的情景中区分语义的有价值的信息编码. 在这部作品中,我们提议为每个语义类配配一个球形-外延分布,作为几何锚. 只有最有自信的视觉基础模型预测的点才在适合产生高质量的几何前分布时加以考虑. 几何前缀与视觉基础模型预测结合,产生最终的语义映射. 拟议之前的SAM3基线在 RELLIS-3D 数据集上改进了+6.3 mIoU 和+8.9 准确度,在 WildScens 数据集上改进+1.7 mIoU 和+2.1 准确度. 原始代码将在接受纸面后公布。

articles.title: DrawScore: Evaluating Generated CAD Models against Engineering Drawings
articles.content: Automatic CAD generation is commonly evaluated with volumetric IoU, Chamfer Distance, and surface F-score, which barely penalize local errors that occupy only a small fraction of a part's volume or surface area, such as a misplaced hole or a slot on the wrong face, even though such errors are critical to manufacturing. We formalize these metrics in a unified integral form and show that the weight of a local error decays as the $(k+q)$-th power of its size, where $k$ is the dimension of the integration domain and $q$ is determined by the penalty function. Guided by this analysis, we propose DrawScore, which projects both models into three orthographic views with visible and hidden lines, as in engineering drawings, and applies a saturating penalty along the projected curves, so that the weight of a local error decays only linearly. Controlled experiments confirm the predicted decay orders, and on outputs of existing CAD generation agents, DrawScore exposes errors in outputs that IoU rates as nearly perfect. DrawScore further improves generation as a reinforcement learning reward and, for CAD generation from engineering drawings, serves as a test-time verifier without 3D ground truth or an additional reward model. Our code is available at https://github.com/UESTC-Simon/DrawScore.

articles.title_zh: DrawScore:评价生成的 CAD 反工程绘图模式
articles.content_zh: 自动 CAD 生成通常用量子IoU,Chamfer距离和表面F-core来评价,它们几乎不会惩罚仅占据一部分体积或表面面积的一小部分的局部错误,例如错误的孔或错误面上的插槽,尽管这些错误对制造至关重要. 我们以统一的整体形式使这些衡量标准正规化,并表明当地误差的权重作为大小的$(k+q)-th的功率衰减,其中$(k$)是整合域的维度,$q$由罚局函数决定. 在这项分析的指导下,我们提出DrawScore,它将两种模型都投射成具有可见和隐藏线条的三种正图视图,如在工程图画中,并在预测的曲线上应用饱和度的判罚,这样一个局部误差的重量只能线性衰减. 被控制的实验证实了预测的衰变命令,在现有的CAD生成剂的输出上,DrawScore暴露出IoU评分的输出错误几乎是完美的. DrawScore进一步改善了作为强化学习奖励的生成,对于来自工程图纸的CAD一代来说,它充当测试时间验证器,没有3D地面真实性或附加奖励模型. 我们的代码可在https://github.com/ULEC-Simon/DrawScore上查阅。

articles.title: Predicting Species Splits: A Challenging Fine-Grained Benchmark for Category Discovery
articles.content: Widely used category discovery benchmarks have become increasingly saturated and often fail to reflect real-world discovery settings, making long-term evaluation of new methods difficult. We introduce PS-SPLIT, a large-scale fine-grained benchmark for category discovery, motivated by taxonomic splitting: the real-world process by which what was once considered a single species is found to comprise multiple distinct ones. PS-SPLIT contains 79K globally distributed, high-quality, community-collected bird images spanning 771 species, derived from 257 recent real expert-verified taxonomic splits, with associated geographic metadata and full taxonomic hierarchy. The visual differences between categories arising from real taxonomic splits can be very subtle, often requiring significant human expertise to tell apart, making PS-SPLIT a challenging benchmark which we hope will assist in advancing fine-grained category discovery research. Based on taxonomic splitting, we introduce the task of discovery by category splitting, where the goal is to determine which known categories should be subdivided into new finer-grained subcategories. We adapt four generalized category discovery methods to this setting, evaluate existing methods, and show that there is substantial room for future progress.

articles.title_zh: 预测物种分裂:一个挑战性精细分类发现基准
articles.content_zh: 广泛使用的类别发现基准越来越饱和,往往不能反映现实世界的发现环境,因此难以对新方法进行长期评价。 我们引入了PS-SPLIT,这是一个大规模细化的分类发现基准,其动力是分类学的分裂:一个曾经被认为是单一物种的现实过程,通过这个过程发现它包含多个不同的物种。 PS-SPLIT包含分布在全球的79K,高质量,群集的鸟类图像,覆盖771个物种,来源于最近257个真正的专家验证的分类分裂,具有相关的地理元数据和完整的分类等级. 实际分类分裂导致的类别之间的视觉差异可能非常微妙,往往需要大量的人类专门知识来区分,使PS-SPLIT成为一个具有挑战性的基准,我们希望这将有助于推进精细分类发现研究。 基于分类划分,我们引入了按分类划分的发现任务,目的是确定哪些已知的分类应该细分为新的精细分类. 我们调整了四种一般的类别发现方法,以适应这一环境,评价现有方法,并表明今后有很大的进展余地。

articles.title: Piccolo: Co-Evolving Decision Models and Data through Recursive Self-Improvement
articles.content: We present Piccolo, a family of multimodal decision models (0.8B to 27B) that coevolves model capabilities and training data via Agentic Data Engineering and recursive self-improvement (RSI). The models predict probabilities over candidate answers for general-purpose text and visual judgments, agent harnesses, data workflows, and interactive games. Piccolo-27B tops the Decision Index Vision Full leaderboard with a score of 75.59, while Piccolo-9B and Piccolo-4B achieve 68.35 and 67.46, respectively. All three rank first on the Private benchmark in their respective model-size categories. Research agents analyze model behavior, construct training data, conduct experiments, and use the results to refine subsequent proposals. Semantic slices and a shared research memory connect these actions across the model family's development. With training recipes comprising hundreds of thousands of examples, data selection and feedback-driven refinement are central to the self-improvement process. Our large-scale RSI exploration yields three counter-intuitive insights for decision-model development: (1) Backbone-recipe co-adaptation outweighs raw model recency: earlier backbones can surpass newer generations on visual tasks under identical recipes; (2) Targeted data curation enables 4B-9B models to rival 27B baselines on specialized workflows; and (3) Continuous loss reduction can decouple from and even degrade discrete decision accuracy. Together with the released weights and tools from the Data-Juicer and AgentScope ecosystems, Piccolo provides an actionable blueprint for building frontier decision models and scaling data-driven RSI.

articles.title_zh: Piccolo:通过递归自我改进共同演变的决定模型和数据
articles.content_zh: 我们介绍的是Piccolo,这是一个多模式决策模型(0.8B至27B)的家族,通过代理数据工程和递归自我改进(RSI),使模型能力和培训数据共同演化。 这些模型预测了通用文本和视觉判断、代理工具、数据工作流程和互动游戏对候选答案的概率。 Piccolo-27B以75.59分的成绩登顶了决策索引"Vision Full Leaderboard",而Piccolo-9B和Piccolo-4B分别实现了68.35和67.46分. 三者在各自的模型大小类别中,在私人基准中排名第一。 研究代理人分析模型行为,构建培训数据,进行实验,并利用结果完善后续提案. 语义切片和共享的研究记忆将这些行动贯穿于模型家族的发展. 由于培训方法包括数十万个实例,数据选择和反馈驱动的改进是自我改进进程的核心。 我们的大规模RSI探索产生了三个反直观的洞察力,用于决策模式的发展: (1) Backbone-recipe co-adaptation 大于原始模型重置性:早期骨干在相同食谱下的视觉任务上可以超越新世代;(2) 定向数据重置使4B-9B模型能够在专门工作流程上与27B基线相抗衡;(3) 持续减少损失可以与离散决定精度脱钩甚至降解. Piccolo与来自Data-Juicer和AgentScope生态系统的释放权重和工具一起,为建立前沿决策模型和扩展数据驱动的 RSI提供了一个可操作的蓝图。

articles.title: AggCLIP: Aggregating CLIP for Zero-Shot Multimodal Anomaly Detection
articles.content: Zero-Shot Multimodal Anomaly Detection (ZSMAD) aims to identify both appearance and geometric defects in novel categories without relying on target-specific training data, making it especially valuable in real-world scenarios constrained by data scarcity, privacy concerns, or high annotation costs. While recent approaches successfully adapt vision-language models like CLIP to achieve this open-vocabulary generalization, they still face significant challenges: (i) severe geometric information loss during 3D-to-2D point cloud rendering; (ii) spatially noisy 2D feature maps produced by raw CLIP patch embeddings, compounded by shallow late-stage modality fusion; and (iii) severe cross-modal semantic misalignment due to decoupled processing streams. To address these limitations, we propose AggCLIP, a novel framework that adapts frozen CLIP representations for ZSMAD by explicitly incorporating local geometric structure and visual spatial context. Specifically, to accurately localize fine-grained defects, we design a Geometry-Aware Spatial Aggregation (GSA) module that refines back-projected 3D point features via density-adaptive neighborhood weighting, alongside a Context-Aware Spatial Aggregation (CSA) module that smooths multi-scale 2D patch embeddings using a lightweight trainable adapter. Furthermore, to prevent semantic drift between modalities, we introduce a Dual-Stream Prompt Contrastive (DSPC) loss, which aligns the abstract concepts of normality and abnormality across the point cloud and RGB streams. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed AggCLIP framework achieves state-of-the-art performance on the MVTec 3D-AD and Eyecandies benchmarks under both one-vs-rest and cross-dataset zero-shot settings, notably surpassing the strongest competitive methods by up to 2.9% in pixel-level AUPRO.

articles.title_zh: AggCLIP:零湿多式异常检测综合CLIP
articles.content_zh: Zero-Shot多式联运异常检测(ZSMAD)旨在识别新类别中的外观和几何缺陷,而不依赖于针对特定目标的训练数据,使其在现实世界中特别有价值,因为数据稀缺、隐私问题或注释成本高。 虽然最近的方法成功地调整了CLIP等视觉语言模型,以实现这种开放-vocability泛化,但它们仍然面临重大挑战:(一)3D至2D点云渲染过程中严重的几何信息损失;(二)原始CLIP补丁嵌入产生的空间噪声2D特征图,加上浅的后期模式聚变;以及(三)由于脱钩处理流导致严重的跨模式语义错配. 为了克服这些局限性,我们建议采用AggCLIP,这是一种新颖的框架,通过明确纳入当地几何结构和视觉空间背景来调整ZSMAD的冻结的CLIP表示. 具体地说,为了准确定位精细的纹理缺陷,我们设计了一个几何-智能空间聚合(GSA)模块,通过密度-适应性邻里加权来完善回投射的3D点特征,同时设计一个上下文-智能空间聚合(CSA)模块,利用轻量级可训练适配器来平滑多级2D补丁嵌入. 此外,为了防止模式之间的语义漂移,我们引入了双层快速对流(DSPC)损失(Dusy-Stream Pointcontitive (DSPC)),该损失将点云流和RGB流之间的常态和异常性抽象概念相协调. 广泛的实验表明,拟议的AggCLIP框架在一Vs-rest和跨数据集的零射设定下,在MVTec 3D-AD和Eyecandies基准上实现了最先进的性能,特别是在像素级AUPRO中,超过最强的竞争方法高达2.9%.

articles.title: Hypnos: A Dual-Phase End-to-End Platform for Scalable Continual Learning at the Edge
articles.content: Continual learning (CL) enables neural networks to adapt to non-stationary data streams by mitigating catastrophic forgetting, offering a path to robust, private, and adaptable edge devices. Yet, porting CL to real-world edge devices remains challenging for two reasons: (i) online operation, where sensor data arrives one sample at a time and the device must adapt on-the-fly, and (ii) the low footprint of edge devices, which makes traditional error backpropagation training prohibitive. Inspired by the brain's wake and sleep cycles, the former for rapid adaptation with minimal resources and the latter for long-term consolidation, we introduce Hypnos, an open-source dual-phase platform for efficient CL at the edge. In the wake phase (e.g., daily operation), Hypnos relies on a low-footprint system-on-chip with a RISC-V microcontroller unit (MCU) targeting efficient inference and supporting lightweight gradient-free prototype updates. In the sleep phase (e.g., night-time charging), where wall-plug energy and larger memory budgets are available, a smart charger performs rehearsal-based gradient updates for consolidation. Deployed on a ZCU104 field-programmable gate array (FPGA) and synthesized in a 28-nm process, Hypnos is benchmarked on the CORe50 NICv2-391 protocol. It sets a new state-of-the-art accuracy of 78.6%-81.6% for edge CL systems, with an on-device latency of 7.79s-10.54s per sample depending on activation precision, and requires $3.8\times$ fewer learning steps and $22\times$ less learning compute than quantized latent replay at higher accuracy and comparable latency.

articles.title_zh: Hypnos:边缘可伸缩性继续学习的双阶段端到端平台
articles.content_zh: 持续学习(CL)使神经网络能够适应非固定数据流,减缓灾难性的遗忘,提供一条通往坚固、私有和可适应的边缘设备的道路。 然而,将CL移植到现实世界边缘设备仍然具有挑战性,原因有二:(一) 在线操作,传感器数据一次到达一个样本,设备必须进行飞行调整;以及(二) 边缘设备的足迹低,这使得传统的误差反向传播训练令人望而却步. 受大脑的觉醒和睡眠周期的启发,前者是用最少的资源快速适应,后者是长期整合,我们引入了Hypnos,一个开源双相平台,用于在边缘高效的CL. 在后期(如日常操作),希普诺斯依靠一个带有RISC-V微控制器单元(MCU)的低脚印系统对芯片,瞄准高效推论,并支持轻量级梯度无原型更新. 在睡眠阶段(如夜间充电),在有墙插能量和较大内存预算的情况下,一个智能充电器会进行基于排练的梯度更新以进行整合. Hypnos在ZCU104可实地编程门阵列(FPGA)上部署,并在28nm的工艺中合成,Hypnos以CORe50 NICv2-391协议作为基准. 它为边缘CL系统设定了78.6%-81.6%的全新精度,视激活精度而定,每个样本的机床间隙为7.79s-10.54s,需要3.8\时间的学习步骤减少,22\时间的学习计算比在更高的精度和可比较的空闲度下量化的潜在重播要少.

articles.title: H3Remover: Reinforcing Video Object Removal without Paired Data
articles.content: Pretrained video editors possess rich removal and completion priors, yet may retain targets or alter unrelated content. We present H3Remover, which reinforces MiniMax-H3 Base Ref2VA for video object removal without paired object-free training targets. To discourage superficial edits such as recoloring, a target-removal reward favors calibrated depth changes consistent with revealing farther content. To limit unintended scene changes, a background-geometry reward encourages preservation of relative depth ordering. To preserve background appearance without retaining unwanted shadows or reflections, an appearance reward constrains RGB changes in source-derived protected regions while exempting targets and estimated effects. Frozen HPSv3 complements these constraints with perceptual-quality feedback for synthesized content. Evaluation regions remain fixed across candidates, and DiffusionART optimizes LoRA adapters with the backbone frozen. Experiments show substantial reconstruction gains over original H3, with qualitative comparisons demonstrating more effective object removal and better preservation of surrounding scene content.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: H3 Remover: 在没有Paired数据的情况下加强删除视频对象
articles.content_zh: 训练有素的视频编辑器有丰富的删除和完成前科,但可能保留目标或改变无关内容。 我们提出H3Remover,它强化了MiniMax-H3 Base Ref2VA,用于在不配对的无对象训练目标下清除视频物体. 为了劝阻肤浅的编辑, 如重新涂色, 目标删除奖励会有利于校准深度变化, 为了限制意外的场景变化,背景几何奖励鼓励保持相对深度顺序. 为了保持背景外观而不保留不想要的阴影或反射,外观奖励会限制RGB在来源保护区的变化,同时免除目标和估计影响. Frozen HPSv3用对合成内容的感知质量反馈来补充这些制约. 评估区域在候选人之间仍然固定不变,而 " 传播农业资源 " 方案则优化了LORA适配器,使其骨干冻结。 实验显示比原H3有相当大的重建收益,质的比较表明更有效地清除物体,更好地保存周围的场景内容.

articles.title: EgoJev: Finding Evidence in Egocentric Video by Reading VLM Decisions
articles.content: Questions about long egocentric video often depend on one brief moment, such as the second a hand puts an object down. A vision-language model (VLM) that sees a few evenly spaced frames usually misses it. Training-free methods rank frames with a separate image-text model or ask the VLM to write a time. In a controlled test, the VLM itself locates the moment better when it chooses among labeled frames, and we read this choice from its output distribution. With the same candidates, this choice lands on the evidence more often than image-text scores or a written time span, and it compares all candidates in one decision. Based on this finding, we propose EgoJev, a training-free frame selector for wearable assistants. EgoJev reads where the evidence is from labeled thumbnails and looks again at the windows it points to. It places its few answer frames at the quantiles of the resulting distribution. One frozen VLM selects, answers and returns the evidence time, with no second model. A wearable device can encode its coarse thumbnails while it records. With Qwen3.5-4B and 8 answer frames, EgoJev raises QAEgo4D accuracy from 51.2% with uniform sampling to 62.0%, and it outperforms recent training-free frame selectors on QAEgo4D and MyEgo. A single-level version runs on a Mac and an iPhone.

articles.title_zh: EgoJev: 通过阅读 VLM 在 Egocent 视频中查找证据 决定
articles.content_zh: 关于长长的以自我为中心的视频的问题常常取决于一个短暂的时刻,比如第二只手把物体放下. 一个视觉语言模型(VLM),它看到一些均匀的空间框架通常会错过它. 无训练方法用单独的图像文本模型排序帧,或者要求VLM写一个时间. 在受控测试中,VLM本身在选择标有标签的帧时定位得更好,我们从其输出分布中读取这个选择. 与同一批候选人相比,这种选择往往比图像文本得分或书面时间跨度更常见于证据上,它在一个决定中对所有候选人进行比较。 基于这一发现,我们提议EgoJev,一个可供佩戴的助手的免训练框架选择器. 叶子 Jev读到标注在缩略图中的证据位置, 它将其为数不多的答案框放在所产生的分布的四分位数上。 一个被冻结的VLM选择,回答和返回证据时间,没有第二个模型. 可穿戴的设备可以在记录时编码其粗糙的缩略图. 用Quen3.5-4B和8个答框,EgoJev将QAEGO4D精度由51.2%统一采样提升到62.0%,在QAEGO4D和MyEGO上它的表现超过了最近的无训练帧选择器. 单层版本运行在Mac和iPhone上.

articles.title: DAL: Dynamic Angular Loss for Imbalanced Medical Image Classification
articles.content: Class imbalance remains a major obstacle in medical image classification, where rare but clinically important classes are often overshadowed by majority categories. Although current strategies for reducing bias, including angle-based softmax (ABS) losses, offer strong discriminative features, their behavior in settings with a small number of severely imbalanced classes remains insufficiently understood. Previous approaches that estimate the intrinsic parameters of ABS rely on the assumption of many classes, which does not hold in medical settings. We derive data-driven upper and lower bounds for the scale parameter and an upper bound for the angular margin using negative-angle statistics, and use these to drive a batch-adaptive angular margin (BAAM), which we combine with dynamically-weighted cross entropy (DWCE) to define our dynamic angular loss (DAL). Across four highly imbalanced medical image classification benchmarks spanning dermatology, ophthalmology, and gastrointestinal endoscopy, our method consistently achieves superior balanced accuracy and the lowest coefficient of variation of per-class recall. Although this entails a small performance reduction on majority classes, the gains on minority categories are substantial, yielding a reliable and equitable overall classifier. Our source code is available at: https://github.com/msalman95/DAL.

articles.title_zh: DAL: 平衡医学图像分类的动态角损失
articles.content_zh: 阶级失衡仍然是医学形象分类的一个主要障碍,在这种分类中,罕见但临床上重要的阶级往往被多数类别所掩盖。 虽然目前减少偏差的战略,包括基于角度的软马克思(ABS)损失,提供了强烈的歧视性特征,但是他们在少数严重失衡类的环境下的行为仍然缺乏足够的理解. 以往估算ABS内在参数的方法依赖于许多类的假设,而这些类在医疗环境中并不存在. 我们用负角统计得出了比例参数的数据驱动上下界限和角边的上下界限,并利用这些参数驱动一个批量的适应角边,我们与动态加权的交叉 en(DWCE)结合来定义我们的动态角损耗(DAL). 在包括皮肤病学、眼科和肠胃内膜检查在内的四个高度不平衡的医学图像分类基准中,我们的方法始终实现了较高的平衡准确性,是每类召回的最低变化系数。 尽管这意味着多数阶层的绩效略有下降,但少数群体类别的收益很大,从而产生了可靠和公平的总体分类。 我们的源代码见:https://github.com/msalman95/DAL。

articles.title: ALIVE: Bring Foundation Features to Life with Events
articles.content: Visual foundation models provide powerful representations for diverse tasks, but their features become stale as visual content changes between image observations. Refreshing them requires new frames and repeated runs of a computationally expensive image encoder. We introduce ALIVE, an event-based method that incrementally updates native foundation model features between image observations. Given an anchor image, ALIVE uses subsequent events to transport and correct existing multi-layer features extracted by a frozen DINOv3 encoder. Its lightweight updater is trained end-to-end using only synthetic data, without downstream task supervision, and transfers directly to real-world event streams without any adaptation. Across three real-world datasets and five task-dataset settings spanning object detection, semantic segmentation, and depth estimation, ALIVE outperforms all evaluated event-based methods in every metric. On DSEC, when the anchor frame is 200,ms old, ALIVE improves over anchor-image predictions by 30.9,mAP in detection, 11.6,mIoU in segmentation, and 15.9% in depth AbsRel. Compared with image re-encoding, ALIVE reduces FLOPs by 82.4% and latency by a factor of 2.5.

articles.title_zh: 生活:使基金会的特色与事件一起生活
articles.content_zh: 视觉基础模型为各种任务提供了强大的表现力,但其特性随着视觉内容在图像观察之间的变化而变得僵化. 刷新它们需要新的帧和重复运行一个计算昂贵的图像编码器. 我们引入了基于事件的方法ALIVE,在图像观测之间逐渐更新本土基础模型特征. 赋予锚定图像,ALIVE使用后续事件来传输和纠正由冷冻的DINOv3编码器提取的现有多层特性. 其轻量级更新器是经过训练的端到端只使用合成数据,不使用下游任务监督,并在没有任何适应的情况下直接转移到现实世界的事件流. 通过三个现实世界数据集和五个任务数据集设置,涵盖对象检测、语义分解和深度估计,ALIVE在每一个度量中都超越了所有评价的事件方法。 在DSEC上,当锚架为200,ms时,ALIVE比锚-影像预测改进了30.9,mAP在探测中,mIoU在分化中,15.9%在深度AbsRel. 与图像重编码相比,ALIVE将FLOP减少82.4%,延迟减少2.5倍.

articles.title: BaseRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement of a Base Vision-Language Model via Training-Free Harness Internalization
articles.content: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) is moving from the harness of prompts and tools around a base model toward the model itself. However, existing RSI still faces key challenges, including harness-bound gains that stay outside the base model, black-box supervision that reads only the model's outputs, and imprecise edits whose site and strength are fixed in advance. To address these challenges, we propose BaseRSI, a new paradigm of Recursive Harness Internalization: the base model improves its harness, then writes what the harness adds into its own weights through training-free edits, round after round on its own responses. To support this paradigm, we introduce ReGap, a mechanism that supervises every transformer block with the high-dimensional activation difference that the harness makes at that block alone, and updates the block's weights along this signal in a low-dimensional subspace. Building on this mechanism, we further propose ReKey, an algorithm that writes this signal by regression into a few key-value neurons of every block, and measures the site and strength of each edit on the model's own responses. Moreover, the base model fills every role of this recursion with forward passes alone, and its edits, written at different sites, compose in one checkpoint without refitting. Experimental results on ten visual reasoning benchmarks show that BaseRSI consistently improves a base vision-language model both in distribution and on held-out benchmarks. Our code is available at https://github.com/beita6969/BaseRSI.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: BaseRSI:通过培训-免费服务内部化,对基地视野-语言模型进行自我改进
articles.content_zh: 递进式自我改进(RSI)正在从一个基建模型周围的提示和工具的利用转向模型本身. 然而,现有的区域信息系统仍然面临重大挑战,包括不受基准模式约束的利用收益、只读模型产出的黑箱监督、以及网站和实力事先固定的不准确编辑。 为了应付这些挑战,我们提议BaseRSI, 内化循环的新范式: 基础模型改进了它的驾驭, 然后通过免费的编辑, 逐个回转, 写下它给自己的重量。 为了支持这个范式,我们引入了ReGap这个机制,这个机制可以监督每个变压器块, 上面有高维的激活差值, 光是在那个块上, 并且用一个低维的子空间来更新这个块的重量。 基于这个机制,我们进一步提出ReKey,这个算法通过回归将这个信号写成每个区块的几个关键值神经元,并在模型自己的响应中测量每个编辑的站点和强度. 此外,基数模式仅用前方通行证填补了这种重复的每一个角色,其编辑则在不同的站点写成,在一个检查站编成,而不复发。 关于10个视觉推理基准的实验结果显示,BaseRSI在分发和搁置基准上都不断改进一个基本视觉语言模型。 我们的代码可在https://github.com/beita6969/BaseRSI上查阅。

articles.title: Beyond Appearance: Evidence-Guided Programmatic 3D Scene Reconstruction with Agentic Lighting Reasoning
articles.content: Image-to-code methods for 3D scene reconstruction produce executable code that generates editable digital content and supports visual simulation. However, existing methods primarily rely on appearance similarity, which provides limited guidance for distinguishing errors in geometry, materials, and illumination. Light shapes scene appearance through its interactions with geometry and materials, influencing shading, cast shadows, and reflections. We therefore present LightHarness, a VLM-based agentic framework that incorporates explicit lighting reasoning into iterative scene reconstruction. To be specific, we leverage complementary geometric, intrinsic, and illumination cues to jointly refine scene structure and appearance, and propose Lighting Reasoning Memory to maintain light-source hypotheses, which supports evidence, and revision history throughout iterations. Together, they support reasoning about partially visible and unseen sources, with evidence-guided verification directing subsequent revisions. Our framework reconstructs explicit scenes through coherent reasoning about geometry, materials, and illumination without additional training or differentiable rendering. Extensive experiments demonstrate superior image-to-code reconstruction accuracy under challenging shadows and complex illumination, further supporting downstream scene editing, object insertion, and versatile relighting.

articles.title_zh: Beyond 外观: 证据指导程序 3D 场景重建与代理照明 原因
articles.content_zh: 3D场景重建的图像到代码方法产生可执行代码,生成可编辑的数字内容并支持视觉模拟. 然而,现有方法主要依赖于外观相似性,这为区分几何,材料,和照明方面的错误提供了有限的指导. 光的形状通过它与几何学和材料的相互作用来呈现场景,影响阴影,投影,反射. 因此,我们介绍LightHarness,这是一个基于VLM的代理框架,将明确的照明推理纳入迭代场景重建. 具体来说,我们利用互补的几何、内在和照明提示,共同完善场景结构和外观,并提出照明理性记忆,以维持支持证据的光源假设,并在整个迭代中修正历史。 它们共同支持关于部分可见和看不见的来源的推理,证据指导核查指导随后的修订。 我们的框架通过对几何学、材料和光线的连贯推理来重建清晰的场景,而不增加训练或不同的渲染。 广泛的实验显示,在具有挑战性的阴影和复杂的照明下,图像到代码重建的精度更高,进一步支持下游场景编辑、物体插入和多功能的照明。

articles.title: SCR: Detecting Backdoor-Poisoned Samples through Clean-Reference Residuals
articles.content: Deep neural networks are vulnerable to backdoor attacks, in which adversaries manipulate model predictions by injecting poisoned samples into training data. Detecting these samples remains challenging because legitimate semantic variation can obscure poisoning-related signals in learned representations. Consequently, class-level statistics used by existing detectors may flag benign feature deviations while overlooking poisoned samples that blend into the class distribution. In this paper, we propose Semantic Counterfactual Residualization (SCR), which uses a small set of clean reference samples to account for benign variation through sample-specific feature reconstruction. SCR identifies poisoned samples by detecting coherent deviations from these clean baselines, without requiring prior knowledge of the attacks. We evaluate SCR through experiments covering twelve dirty-label and clean-label attacks across CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Tiny ImageNet. With a small clean-reference set, SCR achieves attack-averaged true positive rates above 99.5\% and false positive rates below 2\% on each dataset, outperforming eight representative detection baselines in macro-TPR.

articles.title_zh: SCR: 通过清洁参考残留物检测后门-孔径样本
articles.content_zh: 深神经网络容易受到后门攻击,在后门攻击中,对手通过向训练数据中注入有毒样品来操纵模型预测. 检测这些样本仍然具有挑战性,因为正当的语义变异会模糊与中毒有关的信号在学到的表述中. 因此,现有探测器使用的分类统计数据可能标出良性特征偏差,而忽略混入分类分布的有毒样品。 在本文中,我们提出语义反事实残余(SCR),它使用一小组干净的参考样本,通过样本特定特征重建来说明良性变化. SCR通过检测与这些清洁基线的一致偏差来识别中毒样本,而不需要事先知道这些袭击。 我们通过实验来评估SCR, 涵盖整个CIFAR-10,CIFAR-100和Tiny ImageNet的12个脏标签和干净标签攻击。 使用小型的清洁参考集,SCR在每个数据集上达到攻击平均真实正率超过99.5+++,假正率低于2+++,在宏观TPR中表现优于8个有代表性的检测基线.

articles.title: Fuse Before Reconstruct: A Novel Reconstruction Paradigm for Multimodal Industrial Anomaly Detection
articles.content: Industrial anomaly detection plays a pivotal role in precision manufacturing, where joint analysis of multimodal data emerges as a critical approach to enhance detection accuracy. Feature reconstruction, a dominant paradigm for such joint analysis, is primarily implemented through intra-modal and cross-modal methods, both of which are plagued by significant limitations. Intra-modal reconstruction neglects complementary cross-modal information, while its cross-modal counterpart is prone to projection errors and ambiguous one-to-many mappings (e.g., same textures mapping to multiple geometries), leading to detection failures. To address these limitations, we propose a novel feature reconstruction paradigm, Fuse Before Reconstruct (FBR), which first fuses multimodal features and then performs reconstruction for anomaly detection. Firstly, we propose a bidirectional cross-modal attention mechanism to achieve deep feature complementarity between image and point cloud features, mitigating projection bias through channel alignment and dynamic spatial prior integration. Besides, a learnable pixel-wise gated fusion strategy is adopted to preserve multi-modal structural consistency while optimizing local feature combination. Finally, dual-path collaborative reconstruction is implemented to recover original modal features from the fused representations, where cross-modal consistency constraints effectively eliminate mapping ambiguities. Extensive experiments show that FBR achieves 98.3% I-AUROC on MVTec 3D-AD and 92.6% I-AUROC on Eyecandies, surpassing previous state-of-the-art methods by +2.9% and +4.1%, respectively.
