articles.title_zh: 重建前引信:多式联运工业异常检测小说重建范例
articles.content_zh: 工业异常检测在精密制造中发挥着关键作用,在精密制造中,联合分析多式联运数据成为提高精密检测的关键方法。 特征重建是此类联合分析的主要范例,主要通过模式内和跨模式方法实施,这两种方法都受到重大限制的困扰。 模式内重建忽略了互补的跨模式信息,而其跨模式对应方则容易出现投影错误和模棱两可的一对多种绘图(如同一纹理映射到多个几何),导致检测失败. 为了克服这些局限性,我们提出了一个新的特征重建范式,即Fuse Before Reconstruct (FBR),它首先将多式联运特征引信化,然后进行异常探测的重建。 首先,我们建议建立一个双向跨模式关注机制,以实现图像和点云特征之间的深度互补,通过信道对齐和动态空间前集成来减少投影偏差。 此外,还采用了可学习的像素-视门式聚变战略,以保持多模式结构的一致性,同时优化本地特征组合。 最后,还开展了双向协作重建,以从组合的表述中恢复原始模式特征,因为交叉模式的一致性限制有效地消除了绘图的模糊性。 广泛的实验表明,FBR在MVTec 3D-AD上实现了98.3%的I-AUROC,在眼罩上实现了92.6%的I-AUROC,分别以+2.9%和+4.1%。

articles.title: SCRiD: Spatial and Contextual References for Generalizable AI-Generated Video Detection
articles.content: Generalizable AI-generated video detection remains challenging because natural motion and content variations can resemble synthesis artifacts, making isolated video discrepancies unreliable indicators of authenticity. To address this challenge, we propose Spatial and Contextual Reference-informed Detection (SCRiD), a framework that interprets video variations through complementary spatial and contextual references. Specifically, we introduce Matched-Coordinate Residual Response (MCR) to characterize temporal residual associations under motion and coordinate references with matched subpixel sampling conditions. We further develop Real-Conditioned Score Adaptation (RCSA), which learns a content-conditioned denoising reference from authentic videos and probes its responses across multiple noise scales and quality views to guide feature adaptation. To integrate these complementary sources of evidence, we design Reversible Evidence Exchange (REE) to enable information exchange through reversible symplectic updates. We train SCRiD using synthetic videos from only 4 generators and evaluate it across 88 generator or task subsets spanning 6 benchmarks. Our method achieves average ACC and AP of 72.72% and 74.23%, respectively, outperforming the strongest baseline by 3.24 and 0.81 percentage points.Ablation and robustness experiments further validate the effectiveness of the proposed components and the stability of SCRiD under common post-processing operations.

articles.title_zh: SCRID:通用AI-Gened视频检测的空间和背景参考
articles.content_zh: 一般的AI生成的视频检测仍然具有挑战性,因为自然运动和内容变化可以类似于合成文物,使得孤立的视频差异不可靠的真实性指标. 为了应对这一挑战,我们提议采用空间和背景参考信息检测(SCRID)这一框架,通过互补的空间和背景参考来解释视频变化。 具体地说,我们引入了匹配-协调残余反应(MCR),以描述运动下的时间残留关联,并协调与匹配的子像素采样条件的参考. 我们进一步发展Real-Contestioned Score Reformation(RCSA),从真实视频中学习到一个内容条件化的去诺参考,并探索其在多个噪声尺度和质量视角中的反应,以指导特征适应. 为了整合这些补充证据来源,我们设计了可逆转证据交换(REE),以便通过可逆转的同义更新来进行信息交流. 我们只使用4个发电机的合成视频来训练SCRID, 并且通过88个发电机或超过6个基准的任务子集来评价它。 我们的方法使ACC和AP的平均成绩分别达到72.72%和74.23%,比最强的基准高出3.24和0.81个百分点。 在共同的后处理业务中,对拟议部件的有效性和SCRID的稳定性进行了进一步验证。

articles.title: RAID: Representation Autoencoder for Intrinsic Decomposition
articles.content: Single-image intrinsic decomposition is an inherently ill-posed problem, requiring the disentanglement of strongly coupled appearance factors from a single RGB observation. Recent methods address this ambiguity with diffusion priors, at the cost of large, iterative, and often stochastic models. We show that accurate decomposition does not require a large generative model. Our key idea is to decouple reconstruction from decomposition on top of a strong pretrained representation. First, an $X \rightarrow X$ teacher learns to reconstruct each intrinsic map from DINOv3 features using a shared decoder, without paired RGB-to-intrinsic supervision. Then, a DINOv3-based student predicts the corresponding teacher representations from RGB through lightweight, modality-specific projections, enabling training on partially annotated datasets and predicting all intrinsics in a single forward pass. \textbf{RAID}, predicts intrinsic properties in the structured latent space, enabling a compact 165M-parameter model, 100x faster than diffusion-based methods. Despite its compact size, it achieves competitive or superior decomposition quality, with improved robustness to input resolution. Additionally, our learned projections yield interpretable, modality-specific feature spaces.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: RAID: 内分解代表自动编码器
articles.content_zh: 单像内在的分解是一个内在的不合理问题,需要从单一的RGB观察中分解强烈结合的外观因素. 最近的方法用传播前科来解决这种模糊性,代价是大型的、迭代的、而且往往是有条理的模型。 我们显示,准确的分解不需要一个大的基因模型. 我们的关键想法是把重建与分解脱钩 放在一个强大的事先训练过的代表之上 首先,一位$X\右旋X$的老师学会使用共享的解码器重建来自DINov3特性的每个内在地图,而不进行RGB对内监管. 然后,一个基于DINOv3的学生通过轻量级,模式特异性的预测预测RGB的相应教师表现,使得能够对部分附加注释的数据集进行培训,并预测单个前传中的所有内在内容. \textbf{RAID},预测结构化潜伏空间的内在性质,使得一个紧凑的165M参数模型,比基于扩散的方法快100x. 尽管规模不大,它还是实现了竞争性或优越的分解质量,提高了投入分辨率。 此外,我们学到的预测产生了可解释的、具体模式的特征空间。

articles.title: Comparing Each Generation with Independent Siblings Gives Video World Model Post-Training a Proper Objective for Outcome Frequencies
articles.content: Video world models are used as simulators, so when a first frame leaves several physical outcomes open, repeated generations should produce each outcome as often as it occurs in the data. Physics post-training scores every generation against the single recorded future of its history, which makes single videos more faithful, but the expected score is linear in the model distribution and is maximized by always producing the most likely outcome. The log-likelihood of the recorded outcome is maximized by the data distribution, and its gradient weights agreement with the record by the inverse of how often the model produces the generated outcome, a frequency that other generations of the same history with independent noise, its siblings, can estimate. To train with this weight from a finite group, we propose SibPO, which performs Sibling-paired Policy Optimization: siblings estimate a truncated inverse-frequency weight for agreement with the record, and a second term subtracts the same weight times the agreement with the siblings, which makes the expected objective a strictly proper divergence over outcome cells at every group size. On PisaBench, SibPO lowers the KS distance to simulated landing times by 9.1-10.2% relative to the strongest method outside its reward family on three of four video models without degrading single videos, and it lowers the error of estimated robot policy success rates by 13%.

articles.title_zh: 将 " 每代人 " 与 " 独立兄弟 " 进行比较,使视频世界模式在培训后为结果花样设定适当目标
articles.content_zh: 视频世界模型被用作模拟器,因此当第一个帧留下几个物理结果打开时,重复代应像数据中发生的那样频繁地产生每个结果. 物理训练后的分数每代都与其历史的单曲录制的未来相对比,这使得单曲录制的视频更加忠实,但预期的分数在模型发行中是线性的,并且总是通过产生最可能的结果而最大化. 记录结果的对数相似性通过数据分布得到最大化,其梯度权重与记录一致,相反的是模型产生生成结果的频率,这个频率是具有独立噪音的同一历史其他几代人,其兄弟姐妹可以估计的. 为了从一个有限的群体中培养这种重量,我们提议SibPO,它执行兄弟般的政策优化:兄弟姐妹们估计与记录一致的截断反频率重量,第二个术语减去与兄弟姐妹们的协议的相同重量倍,这使预期目标在每组规模上对结果细胞形成严格的适当差异。 在比萨奔奇上,SibPO将KS距离降低到模拟着陆时间,比其奖励家族以外的最强方法在4个视频模型中3个没有贬低单个视频,将估计机器人政策成功率的误差降低13%.

articles.title: RECLAIM: Robot-Vision-Informed Adversarial Patch Defense via Embodied Attention Feedback
articles.content: Vision-language-action policies control embodied agents through a perception-action loop grounded in physical interaction, where adversarial patches can corrupt action predictions and thereby alter subsequent observations. To mitigate these threats, many existing defenses rely on policy adaptation or auxiliary models, but require additional training or inference. We introduce RECLAIM, a training-free, inference-time defense that uses a frozen VLA's own attention response to local visual interventions to guide purification during closed-loop embodied manipulation. Our key insight is that attention changes induced by local edits provide feedback for choosing where and how to purify as the robot interacts with its environment. RECLAIM combines this feedback with robot geometry to refine patch localization and select local treatments, then revalidates them as the agent's embodied actions change the observed scene. We evaluate RECLAIM against patches generated by four adversarial attack methods across multiple manipulation task suites under frozen VLA control. Under adversarial patch attacks, RECLAIM succeeds in at least one rollout on 95% of the evaluated tasks and raises rollout success on LIBERO-Object from 0% without defense to 70.0%. Its mean decision time is only 548.9 ms per control step. These results highlight policy-guided visual purification as an effective approach to defending embodied agents against adversarial patches and recovering closed-loop task execution.

articles.title_zh: RECLIM:机器人-视觉-成型 反面补丁防御 通过体质的注意反馈
articles.content_zh: 视觉-语言-行动政策控制通过一种基于物理互动的认知-行动循环来体现代理人,在这种循环中,对抗性补丁可以破坏行动预测,从而改变随后的观察。 为了减轻这些威胁,许多现有的防御依靠政策调整或辅助模式,但需要额外的培训或推论. 我们引入了RECLAIM,一种无训练的,推论的防御,它使用VLA自己对局部视觉干预的注意反应,指导闭路内装操纵时的净化. 我们的关键见解是,由本地编辑引发的注意力变化,为选择机器人与其环境相互作用的地方和方式提供反馈。 RECLAIM将这种反馈与机器人几何结合,以完善补丁本地化并选择局部治疗方法,然后随着代理器的内含动作改变被观测到的场景而重新验证. 我们对照四种对抗性攻击方法产生的补丁来评价RECLAIM,这些补丁跨越了被冻结的VLA控制下的多个操纵任务套件. 在对抗性补丁攻击下,RECLAIM在95%的评估任务上至少成功推出一次,并将LIBERO-Object的推出成功率从没有防御的0%提高到70.0%. 其平均决定时间仅为每个控制步骤548.9毫秒. 这些成果突出表明,以政策指导的视觉净化是有效方法,用以保护有形代理人免受对抗性补丁的伤害,并恢复封闭式脱落任务的执行。

articles.title: Every Query Routes Itself: Accelerating Video Diffusion Transformers with Per-Query Routed Sparse Attention
articles.content: Self-attention over long token sequences dominates the inference cost of video diffusion transformers. Clustering-based sparse attention clusters both queries and keys and lets all queries in a cluster share one selection of key clusters. We show that this sharing limits accuracy: with key clusters and density fixed, attention grows more accurate as the query clusters are refined, and is most accurate when each query selects on its own, which needs no query clustering at all. We therefore propose Per-Query Routed Sparse Attention (PQRS), a training-free method that clusters only keys, lets each query select its own key clusters, and compensates for the unselected ones with their centroids. Per-query selections leave no query tile with a shared key list, so PQRS traverses key clusters instead of queries, buckets queries with identical selections into dense tasks, and merges their partial results in one pass under a fixed softmax offset carried from the previous denoising step. On four text-to-video and image-to-video models from the Wan and HunyuanVideo families, PQRS is the fastest of all the sparse attention methods we evaluate and the closest to the dense output, reaching $28.9$ dB PSNR on Wan2.1-T2V and $35.4$ dB on HunyuanVideo at $1.66$--$2.10\times$ end-to-end speedup.

articles.title_zh: 每个查询路线本身: 加速带查询路线的视频传播变换器
articles.content_zh: 视频传播变压器的推论成本占主导地位。 基于集群的稀疏关注集群既包括查询,也包括密钥,让一个集群中的所有查询共享一个选定的关键集群. 我们显示,这种共享限制精度:随着关键集群和密度的固定,随着查询集群的完善,注意力越来越准确,当每个查询自行选择时最准确,这根本不需要查询集群. 因此,我们提议Per-Query Routed Sparse Record(PQRS),这是一种无训练的方法,它只将密钥集群,让每个查询选择自己的密钥集群,用它们的百分数来补偿未选中的密钥集群. Per-query 选择没有带共享密钥列表的查询砖,因此PQRS将密钥集群而不是查询,将具有相同选择的查询桶合并为密集任务,将其部分结果合并为一次通过,由之前的解密步骤所携带的固定软max抵消. 在Wan和HunyuanVideo家族的4个文本到视频和图像到视频模型上,PQRS是我们评价的所有稀疏关注方法中最快的,也最接近密集输出,在Wan2.1-T2V上达到28.9美元 dB PSNR,在HunyuanVideo上达到35.4美元 dB,价格为1.66美元-2.10\时间-末速.

articles.title: Anchoring with Visual Evidence: Explicit Semantic Anchors for Joint Change Detection and Captioning
articles.content: Joint change detection and captioning seeks to localize changes and describe them from bi-temporal remote sensing images. A key challenge is translating dense visual evidence into the semantic conditions that guide description generation. We propose Explicit Semantic Anchors (ESA), a supervised interface that exposes entity presence, temporal appearance variation, and spatial extent. A prediction-guided readout combines visual features and predicted change probabilities, and three factor heads estimate the corresponding anchor activations. These activations guide generation through two complementary routes. The context route maps the three factor activations to three separate memory tokens, one per factor, and appends them to the dense visual memory, while the lexicon route produces an additive vocabulary bias at each decoding step. Dense visual memory remains available for spatial detail and information beyond the explicit factors. Anchor targets are derived from existing images and change annotations, requiring no additional anchor-level language annotation. At inference, all conditions are computed from the input image pair and the model's own predictions. Experiments on LEVIR-MCI and WHU-CDC show strong joint detection and captioning performance, supporting the use of supervised visual attributes as explicit conditions for change description generation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 带有视觉证据的安抚:共同发现和说明变化的明确语义定律
articles.content_zh: 联合变化探测和字幕力求将变化本地化,并从双时遥感图像中加以描述。 一个关键的挑战就是将密集的视觉证据转化为指导描述生成的语义条件. 我们提议明确语义控制器(ESA),这是一种可监督的界面,暴露实体的存在、时间外观变化和空间范围。 一个预测制导的读取结合了视觉特征和预测的变化概率,三个因子头估计了相应的锚点激活. 这些激活通过两个互补路线引导生成. 上下文路由将三个因子激活映射到三个独立的内存符号上,每个因子一个,并附加在密集的视觉内存上,而Lexicon路由则在每个解码步骤上产生一个添加性词汇偏差. 强烈的视觉内存仍然可用于空间细节和超出明确因素的信息。 锚定目标来自现有的图像和更改说明,不需要额外的锚定级语言注释. 推论,所有条件都是从输入图像对和模型自己的预测中计算出来的. 关于LEVIR-MCI和WHU-CDC的实验显示强联合检测和字幕性能,支持使用受监督的视觉属性作为变化描述生成的明确条件.

articles.title: ShoWorld: Shape-Faithful Multi-Hypothesis Occupancy World Model
articles.content: Occupancy world models struggle to forecast moving objects due to motion uncertainty and shape distortion. A single trajectory can average plausible futures into an implausible path, and repeated re-voxelization can erode or inflate object shape even under correct motion. We introduce ShoWorld to address these challenges through separate motion and shape representations. The motion forecaster predicts probabilistic trajectories conditioned on scene layout, nearby agents and the future ego trajectory. Each hypothesis is rendered into occupancy and fused according to its probability to retain alternative futures. The shape component predicts sub-voxel points with occupancy probabilities and offsets from local geometry. These points move rigidly with the object, and voxel occupancy follows the probability that at least one occupied point falls within it. This representation reduces shape distortion under motion. ShoWorld achieves state-of-the-art results on Occ3D-nuScenes. With ground-truth occupancy and ego trajectory, it improves mIoU and IoU by 6.56 and 9.16 points overall and by 6.06 and 5.53 points on dynamic classes.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Showorld: 形状- 信仰型多节奏 世界模式
articles.content_zh: 由于运动不确定性和形状扭曲,占用世界模型难以预测移动物体。 单一的轨迹可以平均地将可能的未来推向不可信的路径,反复的重排化甚至可以在正确的运动下侵蚀或膨胀物体形状. 我们介绍ShoWorld,以便通过不同的动议和形式来应对这些挑战。 运动预报器预测以场景布局为条件的概率轨迹,附近的物剂和未来自负轨迹. 每种假说都变为占用,并根据其保留替代期货的概率加以融合。 形状组件预测带有占用概率的子伏塞尔点,并抵消了局部几何. 这些点与物体一起刚性移动, Voxel 占用时会遵循至少一个被占用点落入其中的概率. 这种表述减少了运动中的形状扭曲。 ShoWorld在Occ3D-nuScens上取得最新成绩. 随着地面真实的占用和自我的轨迹,它提高了mIoU和IoU的总的6.56和9.16分,在动态类上提高了6.06和5.53分.

articles.title: EviScope: Evidence-Conditioned Sampling for Long-Range 3D Detection
articles.content: Query-based camera-radar detectors choose where and over which frames each object query samples from the query's position or feature. We test whether radar evidence around the query should also set these choices at the 150 m range of MAN TruckScenes, where recall differs across object-level radar-return counts within every range band. EviScope is a minimal test: the current frame's returns form a non-learned bird's-eye evidence field, which each query reads at its decoded centre to scale its radial sampling extent and to weight eight frames. It adds 5,450 parameters (0.009%) to RaCFormer, with no latency increase in our timing. Our module-free recipe exceeds the published TruckScenes mAP (25.9 over seven runs against 24.1), so we measure the module only against its own baseline at matched seeds. The evidence a query reads rises with its object's return count (Spearman 0.51) but captures zero-return objects only in part, and the learned radius tracks it ($ρ\approx-0.91$ in four runs). Over seven four-epoch pairs the module changes NDS by $+0.31\pm0.36$ and mAP by $-0.27\pm0.22$ (mean $\pm$ SE). Against a geometry-only conditioner with the same parameter count, trained at three matched seeds, it is higher by $+1.25\pm0.72$ NDS and $+0.87\pm0.21$ mAP, on mAP in every pair, and the control's mean NDS is near the baseline's. An exploratory far-range gain failed an internally pre-specified held-out test, and large inference-time substitution penalties also occur without query-local evidence: neither learned allocation nor inference-time dependence substitutes for matched end-to-end comparisons.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: EviScope:长距离3D检测的有证据的样本
articles.content_zh: 基于查询的相机雷达探测器从查询的位置或特性中选择每个对象查询样本的位置和范围。 我们测试周围的雷达证据 是否应该将这些选择设定在 150米范围内 MAN卡车Scens, 其中的召回 不同对象级 雷达返回计数 在每一个范围带。 EviScope是一个最小的测试:当前帧的返回形成一个非吸取的鸟眼证据场,每个查询都在其解码中心读取,以显示其射线采样范围,并重八帧. 它为RaCFormer增加了5,450个参数(0.09 %),而我们的时间没有延长。 我们的无模块配方超过了已公布的卡车Scens mAP(25.9对7对24.1),因此,我们仅根据相应的种子量测该模块的基线。 一个查询读取的证据随其对象的返回计数(Spearman 0.51)而上升,但只捕捉部分零返回的物体,所学的半径跟踪它(在四跑中约0.91美元). 超过7对4个世纪的模块将NDS修改为+0.31\pm0.36美元,MAP修改为0.27\pm0.22美元(平均$\pm$SE)。 对照一个具有相同参数计数的仅几何条件器,经过三个匹配种子的训练,在每对的mAP上,其比比基数更高的是+1.25\pm0.72美元NDS和+0.87\pm0.21美元mAP,控件的平均值NDS接近基准数. 一项探索性远程收益未能通过内部预先规定的预留测试,大型推论时间替代处罚也发生在没有查询-当地证据的情况下:既无知识分配,也无推断时间依赖性替代匹配的端到端比较.

articles.title: Retroactive Concept Bottleneck Models for Exemplar-Free Class-Incremental Learning
articles.content: Exemplar-free class-incremental learning (EFCIL) requires models to learn new classes sequentially without retaining training samples from previous tasks. Continual concept bottleneck models (CBMs) make their predictions interpretable by identifying visual concepts in an image and using them to score each class. However, these methods typically focus on preserving learned concepts or approximating past classes with generated features, which can leave new concepts underused in old-class predictions. We propose RetroCBM, which retains a small set of vocabulary-independent statistics relating frozen visual features to the embedding space of a pretrained vision-language model. Even after earlier training images have been discarded, we can use these statistics to supervise new concepts. To do so, we develop a retroactive regression rule that yields the same predictor for each new concept as class-balanced ridge regression on all images seen so far. We then reproject the stored statistics to recover the full-history squared classification loss and thus learn how much each new concept should contribute to old-class predictions. Since the classifier may use systematic concept errors to distinguish nearby classes, we further introduce a graph-weighted penalty on the margin shifts caused by those errors. Across six datasets, RetroCBM outperforms state-of-the-art interpretable methods in all class-incremental settings, with an 18.1\% relative gain in mean average incremental accuracy over the strongest exemplar-free baseline.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Exemplar-Free Class-Incredital 学习的反演概念博特伦克模型
articles.content_zh: Exemplar-无课-增量学习(EFCIL)需要模型依次学习新课而不保留以前任务的培训样本. 连续的概念瓶颈模型通过在图像中识别视觉概念并利用它们来评分每一类,使其预测可以解释. 然而,这些方法通常侧重于保留已学到的概念,或用产生的特征来近似于过去的类,这可能会使新概念在旧类预测中得不到充分利用. 我们建议采用RetroCBM,它保留了一套关于冷冻视觉特征与预先训练的视觉语言模型嵌入空间的词汇独立的统计。 即使在早先的培训图像被丢弃之后,我们仍可以利用这些统计数据监督新的概念。 为此,我们制定了追溯回归规则,在迄今看到的所有图像上,每个新概念的预测器与类平衡脊回归相同。 然后,我们重新预测所储存的统计数据,以恢复整个历史平面的分类损失,从而了解每个新概念应如何有助于旧的预测。 由于分类者可能使用系统的概念错误来区分附近的分类,我们进一步对这些错误造成的差值变化引入了图表加权的处罚. 在所有6个数据集中,RetroCBM在所有类递增设置中都超过了最先进的可解释方法,平均递增精度比最强的无实例基线有18.1+%的相对收益。

articles.title: NativeSeg: Native Vision Language Segmentation of 3D Computed Tomography via Spatial Visual Tokens and Verified Local Zoom
articles.content: Text prompted 3D computed tomography (CT) segmentation requires both full slice context and fine boundary precision across volumes where over $80\%$ of organ prompted slices lack the queried target. Existing medical vision language models (VLMs) are largely non native segmenters: they delegate pixel delineation outside the VLM by compressing reasoning into a 1D [SEG] vector for an external Segment Anything Model (SAM) decoder, quantizing masks into lossy discrete codebooks, or issuing box prompts to stateless external SAM tools without empty slice screening or spatial state memory. We introduce NativeSeg, a native vision language segmentation framework on Low Rank Adaptation (LoRA) adapted Qwen3.8-27B that performs dense mask decoding, volumetric triage, spatial error self diagnosis, and multiround local zoom directly over the VLM's 2D spatial visual tokens without external SAM decoders. NativeSeg decodes confidence maps from upper layer 2D spatial tokens fused with a five slice U-Net pathway, halts at zero zooms on $>91\%$ of standalone evaluations via a native presence gate (<pres>), localizes uncertain boundaries via a 20 cell multiscale error gate (<err>), and accepts zoomed updates only when predicted error decreases. Trained solely on adult CT, NativeSeg improves Round $0$ DSC by $+19.81$ and $+7.04$ points over discrete codebook and 1D [SEG] readouts on the identical backbone, reaches $86.81\%$ adult and $87.04\%$ zero shot pediatric DSC, and safely refines 2D nnU-Net ($89.52\%$ adult; $86.86\%$ pediatric), 3D SegVol ($86.81\%$), and 3D VoxTell ($89.85\%$).
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 土著Seg:通过空间视觉托肯和校验本地缩放进行3D计算图谱的土著视觉语言分区
articles.content_zh: 文字激发的 3D 计算成像( CT) 片断既需要完整的上下文, 也需要精细的跨卷边界精度, 其中80美元以上的器官激发的片断缺少被询问的目标 。 现有的医学视觉语言模型(VLM)基本上是非本土分解器:它们通过将推理压缩为外部分解模型(SAM)的1D[SEG]矢量,将口罩量化为丢失的离散代码簿,或者在没有空切片筛选或空间状态内存的情况下向无国籍的外部SAM工具发出框提示,将像素划分到VLM之外. 我们引入了NublicSeg(英语:NublicSeg),一个关于低阶适应(英语:Lora)的本土视觉语言分解框架(英语:Low Rank Resignation (Lora)),经过改造的Quen3.8-27B,在VLM的2D空间视觉标志上直接进行密集的口罩解码,体积分解,空间误差自我诊断,并进行多轮局部放大,没有外部SAM解码器. 土著 Seg解码来自上层的2D空间信号符的置信地图,与5个切片的U-Net路径连接,通过本土存在门(<pres>),以0 > 91美元/%的零放大值停止独立评价,通过20个单元格多尺度错误门(<err>)定位不确定边界,仅在预测错误减少时才接受缩放更新。 仅接受成人CT培训的NationalSeg将0美元DSC回合比离散的密码本增加19.81美元和7.04美元,并在相同的主干上读取1D(SEG),达到86.81美元和87.04美元;安全精炼2D nnU-Net(89.52美元成人;86.86美元儿科)、3D SegVol(86.81美元)和3D VoxTell(89.85美元)。

articles.title: Explainable and CPU-Efficient Brain Tumor Classification from MRI Using Two-Phase EfficientNetB3 Fine-Tuning
articles.content: Brain tumors are among the most lethal neurological disorders, with over 308,000 new diagnoses annually worldwide. Accurate classification of tumor type from Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) scans is critical for treatment planning; however, manual radiological interpretation is time-consuming and prone to inter-observer variability. This paper proposes an automated deep learning pipeline for four-class brain MRI classification (glioma, meningioma, no tumor, and pituitary tumor) using EfficientNetB3 transfer learning with a custom classification head. A two-phase training strategy is adopted: Phase 1 trains the head with a frozen backbone (best validation accuracy: 92.77%), and Phase 2 selectively fine-tunes the top 37 layers at a 100x reduced learning rate (best validation accuracy: 94.91%). On an independent balanced test set of 1,600 MRI images, the system achieves 90.62% overall accuracy and a macro-average AUC of 0.9854. Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) is integrated for class-discriminative visual explainability. The proposed system simultaneously addresses three dimensions absent in prior work: high accuracy, CPU-only computational efficiency, and clinical interpretability.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 使用双阶段高效NetB3对核磁共振的可解释性和CPU-有效脑肿瘤进行分类 精细的图宁
articles.content_zh: 脑瘤是最致命的神经系统疾病之一,每年全世界有超过308,000例新的诊断。 从磁共振成像扫描(MRI)扫描对肿瘤类型进行准确的分类对于治疗规划至关重要;然而,人工放射解析很耗时,容易发生观测器间变异. 本文提议采用自定义分类头的高效NetB3转录学习,为四级脑核磁共振分类(glioma,meningioma,无肿瘤,以及垂体肿瘤)提供自动化深层学习管道. 通过了分两个阶段的培训战略: 第1阶段用冷冻骨干对头进行训练(最佳验证精度:92.77%),第2阶段有选择地以100×降低的学习率对前37层进行微调(最佳验证精度:94.91%). 在由1600幅核磁共振影像组成的独立均衡测试集中,系统实现90.62%的整体精度,宏观平均AUC为0.9854. 梯级加权类活性映射(Grad-CAM)为班级差异视觉解释性集成. 拟议系统同时处理先前工作中缺失的三个维度:高精度,只使用CPU的计算效率,以及临床解释性.

articles.title: MLIE-CoT: Chain-of-Thought Reasoning via Multi-Level Image Editing
articles.content: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning has proven effective in improving the reasoning abilities of large language models by breaking complex tasks into step-by-step solutions. In recent years, researchers have attempted to extend CoT reasoning to visual generative models to improve their ability to handle complex tasks. However, existing CoT methods for text-to-image generation still rely mainly on textual reasoning and therefore cannot fully use and preserve the correct semantic information already present in an image, as even the most detailed language cannot capture all visual information. With advances in image generation, models such as FLUX and BAGEL can generate images conditioned on visual inputs. Recent work has attempted to carry images forward as context in the chain of thought, but this introduces another limitation: unsuitable earlier images can strongly interfere with the model, while repeated whole-image regeneration introduces new hallucinations at each round and causes them to accumulate. To address these issues, we propose MLIE-CoT, a visual chain-of-thought framework based on multi-level image editing. MLIE-CoT learns to select the repair granularity from three levels, preserving correct semantics whenever possible during reasoning while reducing the effect of incorrect content. To improve the ability of multimodal models to route errors of different severity to appropriate repair levels, we construct an image-repair dataset covering different error cases and use it to train a repair-level router. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MLIE-CoT significantly outperforms both its base models and methods using fixed repair strategies, producing clear improvements across multiple benchmarks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MLIE-CoT:通过多层次图像编辑实现思维链式理性
articles.content_zh: 思维链(CoT)推理实践证明,通过将复杂的任务分解成分步骤的解决方案,有效地提高了大语言模型的推理能力. 近年来,研究人员试图将CoT推理扩展到视觉遗传模型,以提高他们处理复杂任务的能力. 然而,现有的COT用于文本到图像生成的方法仍然主要依赖于文本推理,因此无法充分利用和保存图像中已经存在的正确的语义信息,因为即使是最详细的语言也无法捕捉所有视觉信息. 随着图像生成的进步,FLUX和BAGEL等模型可以生成以视觉输入为条件的图像. 近期的作品试图将图像作为思维链的上下文来前传,但这带来了另一个限制:不合适的早期图像可以强烈干扰模型,而重复的全图像再生则在每一回合引入新的幻觉,并导致它们积累. 为了解决这些问题,我们提出MLIE-CoT,这是一个基于多层次图像编辑的视觉思维链框架. MLIE-CoT学习从三个层次选择修复颗粒,在推理过程中尽可能保留正确的语义,同时降低错误内容的影响. 为了提高多式联运模型的能力,将不同严重性差错路由到适当的修复水平,我们构建了一个涵盖不同错误情况的图像修复数据集,并利用它来训练一个修理级别的路由器. 广泛的实验表明,MLIE-CoT使用固定修理战略,其基本模型和方法都大大超过其基本模型和方法,在多个基准方面产生了明显的改进。

articles.title: Let a Small Model Read First: Faster Prefill for Long Interleaved Image-Text Inputs
articles.content: Vision-language models (VLMs) can answer questions about long interleaved inputs, such as documents of many pages and collections of hundreds of images, but they are slow to start: on inputs of about 100K tokens, the prefill takes most of the wait for the first output token. A common approach prunes the input by scoring its tokens with the target model itself or with a small model of the same family that first writes an answer. However, this scoring takes much of the time that pruning saves. We find that the evidence for a question lies in a few whole units (images or paragraphs), and that a small hybrid model finds them with one attention head of an early layer, even at half image resolution. Based on these findings, we propose SkimPrefill, which lets the small hybrid model read the whole input first, up to that early layer, with images at half resolution. Most layers of the small hybrid model (Qwen3.5-0.8B) run in linear time, so this pass is short. SkimPrefill then ranks every unit with that head and gives the target the top units as an ordinary shorter prompt. One untrained selector serves targets of different model families. Extensive experiments on MMLongBench at 128K tokens, with 19 datasets of five task types, show the effectiveness of SkimPrefill. With 10% of the input tokens kept, SkimPrefill speeds up the prefill of Qwen3.5-9B, Gemma-4-12B and Qwen3-VL-32B by 3.7 times, 11.6 time and 8.2 times while maintaining their average accuracy.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 让一个小模型先读: 为长间隔图像文本输入更快的预填
articles.content_zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)可以解答关于长期互页输入的问题,例如许多页面的文档和数百个图像的收藏,但是它们起步缓慢:在大约100K个符号的输入上,预填需要等待第一个输出符号的大部分时间. 一种共同的方法通过标出其符号来冲压输入值与目标模型本身,或者用同一个家庭的小型模型首先写出一个答案. 然而,这一评分需要很多时间来节省开支。 我们发现,一个问题的证据存在于几个整体单元(图像或段落)中,一个小型混合模型发现它们有一个早期层的注意力头,甚至半图像分辨率. 基于这些发现,我们提出SkimPrefill(SkimPrefill),它让小混合模型首先阅读整个输入,直到早期的层,图像在半分辨率. 小杂交模型(Quen3.5-0.8B)的大部分层都是线性时间运行的,因此这个传球很短. SkimPrefilling随后将每个单位与该头进行排位,并给予目标最高单位作为普通较短的提示. 一个未经训练的选手为不同模范家庭的目标服务。 在128K令牌上对MMLong Bench进行了广泛的实验,共有19个数据集,共5个任务类型,显示了SkimPrefill的功效. 在保存了10%的输入符后,SkimPrefill在保持平均准确性的同时,加快了Qwen3.5-9B,Gemma-4-12B和Qwen3-VL-32B的预填.

articles.title: Probing Physics in Motion Diffusion Models Against Their Own Estimate
articles.content: Recent studies report that video diffusion models "know more than they show": physical properties decode better from their activations than from their inputs or outputs. But a diffusion model computes its clean-sample estimate from those same activations, so such a comparison measures how easily a readout extracts the information. Whether the model hides anything is a separate question. We set out to find hidden physical knowledge in kinematic text-to-motion diffusion models, where the physics of every intermediate estimate can be computed exactly, and recorded every layer along the sampling trajectories of MDM (two checkpoints) and MotionDiffuse. Against the usual baselines the layers do look ahead of the model's own estimate on balance and flight. With every readout tuned the same way, the estimate closes the gap: for balance and flight, adding a layer gains at most 0.01, a size that a positive control shows we would detect. The fall rate of jumps is the one clear exception. Early in denoising, MDM's layers add about 0.08 in $R^2$ (up to 0.11 in a refit) that the estimate does not yet show, and the gain fades as sampling proceeds; on MotionDiffuse it is small and not robust. The estimate also flags floating samples without training, but aborting them saves under a tenth of the compute. In a video model, plausibility that linear probes miss in Wan 2.1's clean latent becomes readable after one fixed nonlinearity.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在运动扩散模型中针对自身估计进行物理实验
articles.content_zh: 近期的研究表明,视频传播模型"知道多于显示":物理属性解码比其激活比其输入或输出更好. 但是,一个扩散模型会从这些相同的激活中计算出它的清洁样本估计值,所以这样的比较测量读出如何容易提取信息. 模型是否隐藏任何东西是一个单独的问题. 我们开始寻找动态文字到运动传播模型中隐藏的物理知识,可以准确计算每个中间估计的物理,并沿着MDM(两个检查站)和MotionDiffuse的取样轨迹记录每一层。 与通常的基线相比,各层确实比模型本身对平衡和飞行的估计更早。 每一个读出都以同样的方式调制, 估计会缩小差距: 对于平衡和飞行, 增加一层增益,最多0.01, 这个尺寸是正控显示我们会发现的。 跳跃的下降率是一个明显的例外. 早期的去诺化,MDM的分层以$R^2美元(在重置中最多为0.11)增加约0.08,估计值尚未显示,收益随着采样过程而逐渐消退;在MotionDiffuse上则小而不坚固. 估计中也标注了未经过训练的浮标样本,但中止它们会省下计算结果的十分之一. 在视频模型中,线性探测器在Wan 2.1的清洁潜伏中缺失的可信性在固定的非线性之后变得可以读取.

articles.title: Resolution as Attention for Efficient Agent Memory Perception
articles.content: LLM-based agents accumulate extensive interaction histories when solving complex, long-horizon tasks, making efficient memory management critical to their performance and scalability. While existing memory management methods primarily focus on what to retain or retrieve, they often overlook how much perceptual detail should be allocated to individual past interactions. We posit that effective agent memory depends not only on the information preserved, but also on the granularity at which each past interaction is perceived. Motivated by this insight, we propose Resolution as Attention (RAA), a memory perception mechanism that uses visual resolution as a means of attention allocation across interaction histories. RAA renders past interactions as images and dynamically adjusts their resolution at every step according to their relevance to the agent's upcoming decision, preserving fine-grained information for critical interactions while reducing visual-token consumption for less relevant ones. To adaptively determine the perceptual fidelity of each interaction, we train a lightweight relevance estimator with teacher-model guidance and further optimize it to preserve the agent's decision consistency at a reduced visual-token cost. Experiments across multiple tasks and backbones show that RAA reduces token consumption by over 50% without compromising task performance. Moreover, RAA can be integrated as a plug-in perception layer with existing memory management methods, yielding further token savings and revealing adaptive perception as a complementary dimension of agent memory.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 分辨率作为高效代理记忆感知的注意
articles.content_zh: 基于LLM的代理在解决复杂,长视距的任务时积累了广泛的交互历史,使得高效的内存管理对其性能和可扩展性至关重要. 虽然现有的内存管理方法主要侧重于保留或检索哪些内容,但它们往往忽略了应分配给过去个人互动的多少认知细节。 我们认为,有效的代理记忆不仅取决于所保存的信息,还取决于对过去每次互动的看法。 基于这种见解,我们提议将“决议”作为“关注”(RAA),这是一种记忆感知机制,它利用视觉分辨率作为在互动历史中分配注意力的手段。 RAA将过去的相互作用作为图像,并根据其与代理商即将作出的决定的相关性,在每一个步骤上动态调整其分辨率,为关键相互作用保留精细信息,同时减少不太相关的可视化的消耗。 为了适应性地确定每一次互动的感知忠实性,我们用教师模型指导来训练一个轻量级相关估计器,并进一步优化它,以降低可视化成本来保持代理商的决定一致性. 跨越多个任务和主干线的实验表明RAA在不损害任务性能的情况下将象征性消费减少50%以上. 此外,RAA可以作为插件感知层与现有的内存管理方法整合,产生更多的象征性节约,并揭示适应感知是代理记忆的一个互补维度.

articles.title: PhysResponse: Probing the Physics of Video Generation with Controlled Interventions
articles.content: Video generation models are increasingly viewed as world simulators, which requires not only plausible motion but dynamics that respond correctly to specified physical parameters. Existing models, datasets and benchmarks, however, largely target physical plausibility, leaving this physical parameter responsiveness insufficiently explored. We introduce PhysResponse, a benchmark that measures it at two levels: scene-conditioned simulator inversion recovers the effective gravity, friction and initial speed of generated motion, and event evaluation tests outcomes near and across critical transitions. Evaluating ten image-to-video models, we find that even the lowest parameter errors exceed those of physically correct videos by over an order of magnitude, that models rarely reproduce both outcomes of a transition pair, and that the two levels expose complementary failures that visual metrics such as PSNR miss. To supply the missing training signal, we construct 72,000 simulated videos of 20 multi-object interaction types with controlled parameters; fine-tuning on them lowers parameter errors, even on held-out interaction types, and transfers to real videos and an external physics benchmark. Continued training with a numerical encoder further lowers all three errors on held-out types. PhysResponse provides a foundation for world simulators that follow physical conditions, not just appearances.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 物理反应 : 利用有控制的干预措施,探索视频生成的物理学
articles.content_zh: 视频生成模型日益被视为世界模拟器,它不仅需要可信的运动,而且需要动态能对指定的物理参数作出正确的反应。 然而,现有模型、数据集和基准主要针对物理可信性,使这一物理参数的响应性没有得到充分的探讨。 我们引入了物理反应(PhysResponse),这个基准在两个层面进行测量:场景条件模拟反演恢复生成运动的有效引力,摩擦和初始速度,以及事件评价测试结果接近和跨越关键过渡. 评估10个图像到视频模型,我们发现即使是最小的参数错误也比物理上正确的视频错误超过一个数量级以上,模型很少复制两个过渡对的结果,两个级别暴露出PSNR等视觉度量错失的互补失败. 为了提供缺失的训练信号,我们构建了72,000个模拟视频,包含20个多对象交互类型,具有可控参数;对它们进行微调,降低参数误差,即使是被搁置的交互类型,并传输到真实的视频和一个外部物理基准. 用数字编码器继续培训,进一步降低了所有三个被搁置类型的错误。 PhysResponse为遵循物理条件,而不仅仅是外观的世界模拟器提供了基础.

articles.title: Why Multi-Source Audio Fails to Compose: A Geometric Diagnosis and Its Remedy
articles.content: Multi-source audio-to-image generation exhibits consistent compositional failures when audio tokens occupy geometrically displaced, semantically unanchored positions in the CLIP text-token space, where the diffusion U-Net lacks the prior to reliably attend to them or ground them in distinct spatial regions. We formalize this as the geometric displacement phenomenon and expose it through a two-level clustering analysis comparing BEATs and CLAP embeddings at the raw encoder and projected CLIP token levels. Three geometric properties emerge as important: intra-class compactness, angular alignment with the CLIP text manifold, and inter-token spatial separation. We show that CLAP, whose contrastive language-audio pretraining aligns embeddings with natural language semantics, substantially outperforms BEATs on all three properties, improving the silhouette score by more than 3x and the Audio-Image Content score as well. Building on this analysis, we introduce a multi-token extension that requires no diffusion-backbone retraining and assigns each audio source to a distinct placeholder token in the CLIP tokenizer, complemented by a mixed inference-time objective that combines Attend-and-Excite with an A* spatial separation loss to resolve residual cross-token interference. For evaluation, we construct multi-audio compositional benchmarks from VGGSound (VGG2, VGG3, and VGGN) and extend six standard audio-image metrics to the multi-source setting. Across five benchmarks and four strong baselines, our method achieves strong results on the metrics most directly tied to compositional faithfulness, with AIC improvements of up to 2.25x over the strongest baseline and FID reduced by nearly 2x on two-source generation. We propose geometric displacement as a diagnostic framework for cross-modal generation systems that project learned embeddings into a pretrained contrastive space.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 为什么多源音频失败来编曲:几何诊断及其补救
articles.content_zh: 多源音频到图像生成显示,当音频符号占据了CLIP文本调试空间的几何位置时,其构象故障始终如一,在CLIP文本调试空间中,扩散U-Net缺乏可靠处理它们或在不同空间区域铺设它们之前的位置。 我们将此正式确定为几何流离失所现象,并通过对BEATs和CLAP嵌入在原始编码器和预测的CLIP符号水平的双层集群分析加以曝光。 三种几何特性作为重要特性出现:类内紧凑性,与CLIP文本的角对齐多面性,以及间距分离. 我们显示,CLAP的对比性语言-音频预训与自然语言语义的嵌入一致,在所有三个属性上都大大超过BEAT,使Silhouette分数提高3x以上,音频-图像内容分数也提高。 基于这一分析,我们引入了一个多键扩展,不需要再进行扩散背骨,并将每个音频源分配给CLIP标语器中一个独特的占位符,辅之以一个混合推论-时间目标,将Attend-and-Excite和A*空间分离损失结合起来,以解决剩余的交叉键干扰. 为了评价,我们从VGGSound(VGG2,VGG3和VGGN)构建了多音频构成基准,并将6个标准音频图像度量标准扩展到多源设置. 在5个基准和4个强基线中,我们的方法在最直接与组成忠诚度相联系的衡量标准上取得了强有力的成果,人工智能的改进比最强基线的改进达2.25x,在双源生成上,FID减少了近2x。 我们建议将几何迁移作为跨模式生成系统的诊断框架,将学习到的系统嵌入一个预先训练的对比空间。

articles.title: StrideWorld: Benchmarking Scene Rigidity and Action Consistency in Interactive Video World Model
articles.content: Interactive video world models turn user commands into the exploration of a generated scene, which requires the scene to keep its 3D structure as the camera moves and each action to keep a stable effect. Existing benchmarks mostly evaluate these properties against references fitted to the video under test, either a scene reconstructed from its own frames or a camera trajectory aligned to the command path with a free scale. Such references can absorb gradual scene deformation and changes in pace and route length, so these errors can pass undetected. We therefore introduce StrideWorld, a benchmark whose references are fixed before the motion they judge. It evaluates scene rigidity against the ground-truth geometry of the start view, and action consistency against the stride of each action, the camera motion of one command. The stride is measured on the model's first steps and then used to test the steps that follow, so each model is judged only against its own steps. Its measurements are validated on rendered videos with known camera motion, and its scores agree with human judgments. Across \nvideos{} videos generated by \nmodels{} open models from $140$ start views, all models but one deform their scenes as the camera moves, with offsets up to $7.3$ times those of a rigid rendering along the same camera path. Most models keep a steady pace when a single action is held. Along composed routes, several models often stall, and most completed routes end away from the positions predicted by each model's own strides. Only the two models that scale commands by the estimated scene depth bring most routes close to these positions. Fine-tuning two models on a few rendered clips removes most of their mid-route stalls. Code, data, and a leaderboard are publicly available at https://github.com/chuangwang123/strideworld.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: StrideWorld:互动视频世界模式中确定场景强度和行动一致性的基准
articles.content_zh: 互动视频世界模型将用户指令转化为对生成的场景的探索,这需要场景在镜头移动时保持其3D结构,以及每个动作保持稳定效果. 现有基准大多根据测试中的视频的参考文献来评价这些属性,这些参考文献要么是从自己的框架重建的场景,要么是和命令路径一致的、具有自由尺度的相机轨迹。 这种引用可以吸收逐渐的场景变形以及速度和路由长度的变化,因此这些错误可以不被发现地通过. 因此,我们介绍StrideWorld,这个基准在他们判断的动议之前,其参考标准是固定的。 它评价场景的刚性与起始视图的地面-真实几何,以及动作一致性与每个动作的脚步,一个指令的相机运动. 在模型的最初步骤上测量脚步,然后用来测试接下来的步骤,因此每个模型只根据自己的步骤来判断. 其测量结果在制作的视频上经过验证,已知的镜头动作,其分数与人类判断一致. 所有模型除了一个外, 多数模式在采取单一行动时保持稳步步伐。 沿着构成的航线,几个型号经常会停滞,大多数完成的航线都从每个型号自身进步所预测的位置上结束. 只有按照估计的场景深度进行测距的两种模型才能使大多数路线接近这些位置. 在几段剪辑上精细调整两个型号, 在https://github.com/chuangwang123/strideworld上可公开查阅代码、数据和领导板。

articles.title: RAPID: Reconstruction Accelerated by Polarization-Informed Depth for 2D Gaussian Splatting
articles.content: Efficient and accurate 3D surface reconstruction from multi-view images remains a fundamental challenge in Gaussian splatting. Many existing methods rely on sparse geometric initialization and iterative densification, resulting in substantial optimization overhead and difficulties in balancing rendering quality and geometric accuracy, particularly in reflective and weakly textured regions. To address these limitations, we propose RAPID, a geometry-first framework that uses multiview polarization cues to recover dense surface priors. We integrate surface normals into depth maps using sparse geometric anchors. These depth maps are then fused across views. Curvature-adaptive sampling and oriented Gaussian initialization then support efficient optimization. Experiments on the PISR dataset demonstrate an approximately \(5\times\) speedup over PhyGaP, which is a state-of-the-art Gaussian-based reconstruction method. RAPID reduces the average optimization time from approximately 21 minutes (PhyGaP) to 4 minutes while maintaining competitive novel-view synthesis quality and mesh reconstruction accuracy. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of RAPID in accelerating Gaussian optimization from polarimetric multi-view inputs.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: RAPID:由极化-成形深度加速重建,用于2D高斯电镀
articles.content_zh: 从多视图图像中高效和准确的3D表面重建仍然是高斯滑板的一个根本挑战. 许多现有方法都依靠稀疏的几何初始化和迭代密度,导致大量优化间接费用,难以平衡渲染质量和几何精确度,特别是在反射和纹理薄弱的区域。 为了消除这些局限性,我们提议采用RAPID这一几何-第一框架,利用多视极化提示来恢复密集的表面前兆。 我们利用稀疏的几何锚把地表常态整合到深度图中. 这些深度图然后被连接到各种视野中。 曲率适应取样和定向高斯初始化后支持高效优化. PISR数据集上的实验显示在PhyGaP上有一个大约\(5\times\)的加速,这是一种最先进的基于高斯的重建方法. RAPID将平均优化时间从大约21分钟(PhyGaP)缩短到4分钟,同时保持竞争性的新颖视野合成质量和网格重建精度. 这些结果表明RAPID在加速从极度多视图输入优化高斯语方面的效力.

articles.title: Reliable Tree Recruitment from Scarce Annotations for Forest Inventory Expansion
articles.content: Species-level inventories of individual tree crowns (ITCs) from UAV imagery are limited by annotation cost: in tropical forests, many species are represented by only a handful of field-validated crowns. We propose a reliable tree recruitment framework that expands a small annotated inventory by iteratively self-training a multi-task DeepLabV3 network, combining semantic segmentation with a crown-distance regression head, on RGB UAV orthomosaics. At each iteration, candidate crowns enter the training inventory only if they pass a confidence filter on class probability and distance map and a morphology filter on crown area and solidity, with at most five new crowns per species, keeping recruited samples consistent with the reference inventory. We evaluate the framework at two Brazilian sites: an Amazonian rainforest in Acre (17 species, 355 annotated crowns, 4 cm GSD) and a forest site in the Cerrado of Maranhão (4 species, 51 annotated crowns, 1.8 cm GSD). Over 20 iterations, the number of retained crowns grew from about 500 to 960 in Acre and from about 700 to over 3100 in Maranhão, while crown-level F1 exceeded single- and multi-task DeepLabV3 baselines (53.5% vs. 50.0% and 45.2%; 92.2% vs. 79.7% and 83.6%). The framework offers a low-cost route to expanding species inventories with consumer-grade UAVs and limited fieldwork.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 根据《关于扩大森林清单的描述》征聘可靠树木
articles.content_zh: 无人机图像中单个树冠(ITCs)的物种级清单受到注释成本的限制:在热带森林中,许多物种只代表少数有实地验证的树冠. 我们提出一个可靠的树源招聘框架,通过迭代自我训练一个多任务DeepLabV3网络,在RGB UAV矫形学上将语义分解与冠-距离回归头结合,扩大一个附加说明的小目录. 在每次迭代时,候选冠须通过班级概率和距离图的置信滤波器和冠区和坚固度的形态滤波器,每个物种最多有5个新冠,才能进入训练清单,使所招募的样本与参考清单保持一致. 我们在巴西的两个地点对框架进行评估:阿克里的亚马逊雨林(17个物种,355个标注冠,4厘米GSD)和马拉尼昂Cerrado的森林地点(4个物种,51个标注冠,1.8厘米GSD)。 超过20次重复,保留王冠的数量在阿克里从500个左右增加到960个,在马拉尼昂从700个左右增加到3100个以上,而王冠级的F1超过了单任务和多任务DeepLabV3基线(53.5%对50.0%和45.2%;92.2%对79.7%和83.6%).6%. 该框架为扩大具有消费级无人驾驶航空器和有限实地工作的物种库存提供了低成本途径。

articles.title: Jailbreak Detection on Large Language Models via Contrastive Prototype Structures
articles.content: Jailbreak attempts and harmful prompts remain a challenge for the safe deployment of large language models. We study whether contrastively learned representations can support safety detection without training an additional downstream classifier. We propose Jailbreak Detection with Prototype Inference (JDPI), which uses binary safety labels to construct harmful and benign prototypes and makes predictions from relative prototype distances. JDPI uses only binary safety labels for encoder adaptation, prototype construction, and validation. In our setup, it uses fewer labeled examples than the classifier baseline (Method A) by avoiding the separate split used to train the downstream classifier. Across four benchmarks covering different input formats, contrastive fine-tuning improves JDPI's detection accuracy by 9.1-18.0 percentage points. Using the same encoder, JDPI achieves slightly higher ROC-AUC on one benchmark and stays within 0.017 of the baseline across all four. With dataset-specific adaptation, JDPI exceeds the released Llama Guard 3-8B baseline by 0.173-0.310 in ROC-AUC across the four benchmarks. In multi-turn replay on TomGibbs, JDPI uses accumulated user history as the conversation unfolds, achieving higher conversation-level accuracy than when it uses the current turn alone. Across 12 directed transfers, JDPI outperforms the classifier by an average of 1.59 percentage points in accuracy, demonstrating stronger cross-dataset robustness.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过对比性原型结构在大语言模型上发现监狱
articles.content_zh: 打破监狱的企图和有害的诱因仍然是安全部署大型语言模型的一项挑战。 我们研究的是,相对而言,学到的表述是否有助于安全检测,而无需再培训一个下游分类器。 我们提议用原型推论(JDPI)进行分解分解检测,使用二进制安全标签来构建有害和良性的原型,并从相对的原型距离进行预测. JDPI只使用二进制安全标签进行编码器的改造,原型建造,以及验证. 在我们的设置中,它使用比分类器基线(Method A)更少的标签示例,避免用于训练下游分类器的单独拆分. 在涵盖不同输入格式的四项基准中,对比性微调使JDPI的检测精度提高了9.1-1.8.0个百分点. JDPI使用同样的编码器,在一个基准上达到略高的ROC-AUC,并保持在所有四个基准的0.017范围内. 随着数据集的适应,JDPI在ROC-AUC中超过释放的Llama Guard 3-8B基线0.173-0.310,超过四个基准. 在TomGibbs上的多回合回放中,JDPI在对话展开时使用累积的用户历史,比单独使用当前转盘时实现更高的对话级别准确性. 在12项定向转让中,JDPI的准确度平均比分类器高1.59个百分点,显示交叉数据集的稳健性更强。

articles.title: Who are you? The Personal Imitation Game
articles.content: Large Language Models (LLMs) now perform strongly on Alan Turing's 1950 Imitation Game, so we propose a harder challenge, the Personal Imitation Game, which asks whether a machine can replicate a specific individual in conversation rather than a generic human. Testing with 30 participants, we establish a human baseline and report the identity signals interrogators rely on: stylometric features, personality traits, and biographical facts. To demonstrate the framework, we design an LLM-based system that plays the game for one of the paper's authors, drawing on an autoethnographic dataset spanning ten years of personal digital communication. In a 20-person deception study, interrogators choose our system over the author's own friends in 7 of 10 rounds, and the author over our system in 13 of 20; neither rate is distinguishable from chance at this sample size. We consider design improvements, applications of personal AI agents, and implications for identity and privacy.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 你是谁? 个人模仿游戏
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)现在在艾伦·图灵1950年的仿真游戏上表现强劲,因此我们提出了更严峻的挑战,即个人仿真游戏,它询问一台机器是否可以在对话中复制一个特定的个体,而不是通用的人类. 在30名参与者的测试中,我们确定一个人类基线,并报告身份信号询问者所依赖的特征、个性特征和传记事实。 为了展示这个框架,我们设计了一个基于LLM的系统,为论文的一位作者播放游戏,利用一个跨越十年的个人数字通信的自动人文数据集. 在20人欺骗研究中,审讯者选择我们的系统,在10轮中的7轮中胜过作者自己的朋友,在20轮中的13轮中胜过作者的系统;在这种抽样规模下,两个率都不能与机会区分. 我们考虑设计改进、个人人工智能的应用以及对身份和隐私的影响。

articles.title: Ground, Iterate, Trace: Decomposing AI Research Ideation
articles.content: Large language models have been widely used to generate plausible research ideas, yet it remains unclear what makes automated ideation effective and how generated novel proposals arise from prior scientific work. We introduce the Creative AI Researcher (CAR), an agentic framework combining literature grounding, iterative development and explicit conceptual operators. CAR constructs a semantic knowledge graph from retrieved literature and equips an ideation agent with graph-retrieval tools and four operators: bisociation, analogy, exploration and elaboration. Each operator call is checked against structural acceptance conditions and recorded, producing a trace of intermediate transformations and declared literature sources. We evaluate CAR with two language-model backbones across 40 LiveIdeaBench research topics and two execution benchmarks. CAR achieves significantly higher methodological novelty (MN) than single-shot prompting and The AI Scientist. Its methodological novelty does not differ significantly from the Research Ideation Agent, while its feasibility scores are higher on both backbones. With a shared experiment executor, CAR achieves the highest pairwise win rate among the evaluated AI methods on FML-bench-Lite and BioXArena. In a ten-condition ablation study, MN point estimates favor CAR over one-step proposal on both backbones, but no MN contrast survives correction for multiple comparisons. The results do not establish a consistent quality benefit from explicit operators beyond free-form iteration. CAR makes the sequence of operations and declared literature sources inspectable, separating judged idea quality from procedural traceability.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 地面、 斜纹、 跟踪: 分解AI 研究思想
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型被广泛用于产生可信的研究想法,但尚不清楚是什么使得自动化想法有效,以及以往科学工作如何产生新的建议。 我们介绍了创意人工智能研究员(CAR),这是一个将文献定位、迭代发展和明确的概念操作者相结合的代理框架。 CAR从检索的文献中构建一个语义知识图,并为一个构思剂配备了图检索工具和四个操作符:类比,类比,探索和阐述. 每个操作员的呼叫都根据结构接受条件进行核对,并记录下来,产生一定的中间转换和申报的文献来源。 我们用两个语言模式的骨干来评价CAR,涉及40个LiveIdea Bench研究课题和两个执行基准。 CAR在方法上的新颖性显著高于单发提示和AI科学家。 它在方法上的新颖性与"研究思想代理人"(Research Ideation Agent)没有显著的区别,而其可行性分数在两种骨干上都较高. 通过共享实验执行器,CAR在FML-bench-Lite和BioXArena上获得评价的AI方法中实现了最高的对偶胜率. 在10个条件的减肥研究中,MN点估计对CAR优于两根骨干上的单步建议,但MN对比无法幸存的多次比较修正. 其结果不能证明明确操作者在自由形式迭代之外具有一致的质量效益。 CAR使行动序列和申报的文献来源可以检查,将判断的思想质量与程序的可追踪性分开。

articles.title: Can Programs Replace LLM Judges? Executable Program Judges for Scalable and Efficient Relevance Labeling
articles.content: Large language model (LLM) judges have become a common way to create large-scale relevance judgments for retrieval evaluation. However, each judgment requires a potentially expensive call to a frontier model, and the judgments are hard to interpret and may not be reproducible. In this paper, we ask whether an LLM can write a readable program for each topic that replaces its per-document judgments. To address these issues, we propose ExecJudges, a method for generating fast, inspectable and scalable judges for automatic relevance labeling. Specifically, ExecJudges uses a frontier LLM to turn assessment guidelines into executable programs, which rely only on lexical matching, standard NLP libraries like parsers, and pool statistics. An ExecJudges-L variant also uses examples of human labels if available. We evaluate ExecJudges on seven TREC collections by comparing the produced labels with trained NIST assessors, frontier LLM judges, and recently proposed per-topic classifiers. Our results show that ExecJudges agrees with NIST assessors at the level of the Claude Sonnet 5.5 LLM judges on TREC DL 2019-2021. With a small number of human labels per topic, the ExecJudges-L variant agrees with NIST more than per-topic classifiers with the same labels on all seven collections, and either exceeds the agreement of LLM judges provided the same labels or is within about 0.05 of it in Krippendorff's alpha. The labels rank the official TREC DL runs with Kendall's tau of 0.87 to 0.94, and writing the programs incurs a one-time cost of $0.17 to $0.49 per topic, with no additional costs for grading. Our results suggest that ExecJudges offers a reproducible, inspectable, efficient and cost-effective alternative to LLM judges for labeling deep result pools for system evaluation or ranking improvements.

articles.title_zh: 可替换 LLM 程序 法官们? 可执行的可扩展和高效相关性标签方案法官
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLM)法官已经成为创建大规模相关判断以进行检索评价的一种常见方式. 然而,每项判决都要求对前沿模式发出可能代价高昂的呼吁,判决难以解释,可能无法复制。 在本文中,我们询问一个LLM是否能够为每个主题写一个可读的程序,以取代其每个文件的判断. 为了解决这些问题,我们提议设立执行法官,这是产生快速、可检查和可扩展法官的方法,以便自动贴上相关标签。 具体来说,ExecJudges使用边疆LLM将评估指南转化为可执行程序,它们只依赖词汇匹配,标准NLP库如解析器,以及集合统计. 一个ExecJudges-L变体如果有的话也会使用人类标签的例子. 我们通过将制作的标签与训练有素的NIST评审员、前沿LLM评审员以及最近提议的每个专题分类员进行比较,对TREC的7个汇编进行评估。 我们的结果显示,执行法官们同意NIST评估员在Claude Sonnet 5.5 LLM法官一级对TREC DL 2019-2021表示赞同。 ExecJudges-L变体每个主题都有少量的人类标签,它同意NIST多于所有7个集合都具有相同标签的每个主题分类器,或者超过LLM法官提供相同标签的协议,或者在Krippendorff的α中在其中约0.05. 标注为官方TREC DL的排名,肯德尔的tau为0.87至0.94,写作程序每题需一次性花费0.17至0.49美元,不需追加分级费用. 我们的结果表明,执行法官为LLM法官提供了一个可复制、可检查、高效和具有成本效益的替代办法,用于为系统评价或排名改进贴上深度成果库的标签。

articles.title: Vibe-Trading: Towards Agent-Native Trading
articles.content: Existing AI agents can retrieve information, call tools, run experiments, and produce multi-step outputs. Yet most are built around relatively static workflows and struggle to preserve reliable state as the environment changes. Financial trading makes this limitation especially consequential: prices, news, market conditions, portfolio positions, and available capital evolve continuously. A result is useful only when it remains tied to the correct time, data snapshot, and execution context. We present Vibe-Trading, a comprehensive agent-native trading framework and all-in-one workspace for building, evaluating, and evolving agents for financial trading. It unifies market research, financial data, strategy generation, backtesting, portfolio analysis, paper trading, multi-agent collaboration, and optional broker execution. Its central contribution is an architecture that keeps results, evidence, research history, and trading authority connected throughout the research-to-action process. Each result retains its source, temporal scope, configuration, and producing run. Shared evidence grounding enables verification, versioned research records support reproducible continuation, and an explicit authority gate separates strategy research from live execution. Together, these designs provide a practical foundation for trading agents whose results can be traced, reproduced, and acted on only under explicit authority.

articles.title_zh: 维贝塔林: 走向代理-国内贸易
articles.content_zh: 现有的AI代理可以检索信息,调用工具,运行实验,并产生多步输出. 然而,大多数工作流程是围绕相对静止的工作流程构建的,并努力随着环境的变化而保持可靠的状态。 金融交易使这一限制特别产生后果:价格、新闻、市场条件、证券组合头寸和可用资本不断演变。 只有当结果与正确的时间、数据快照和执行上下文挂钩时,结果才有用。 我们提出Vibe-Trading,这是一个全面的代理-本土贸易框架,是建立、评价和不断发展的金融交易代理商的全方位工作空间。 它统一了市场研究、金融数据、战略生成、回溯测试、投资组合分析、纸质交易、多代理协作以及可选的经纪人执行。 其中心贡献是使成果、证据、研究历史和贸易权威在整个研究与行动过程中保持联系的架构。 每个结果都保留其来源、时间范围、配置和生产运行。 共享证据可以进行核查,版本研究记录支持可复制的延续,明确的权威门将战略研究与现场执行分开。 这些设计共同为贸易代理提供了实际基础,其成果只有在明确授权下才能追踪、复制和采取行动。

articles.title: General progress substitutes for specific training data in language models
articles.content: Language models acquire their capabilities from training data, and developers withhold data during training to keep models from learning capabilities that could be misused. How long this delays a capability, and how much data is needed to acquire it later, is unknown. Here we show that the general progress a model makes on the rest of its training data substitutes for the data that was withheld. We withheld the training signal for individual skills in models of chess, Othello, molecular strings, bracket languages and web text. The delay of a withheld skill in larger models was predicted from smaller ones. A chess model never explicitly trained to respond to check ranked the legal responses almost as well as a model that was. When models were then trained on the withheld data, they acquired the skill with a small fraction of the data needed from initialization, and this fraction decreased as the models progressed. A control rule of equal difficulty was learned much more slowly. A programming language withheld from the training text of a 7-billion-parameter model was regained in the same way. Data filtering therefore delays a capability, and the data required to regain it decreases as models improve.

articles.title_zh: 语文模式具体培训数据的一般进度替代
articles.content_zh: 语言模型从培训数据中获得其能力,开发者在培训期间保留数据,使模型无法学习可能被滥用的能力. 尚不清楚这种能力延迟了多久,以及以后需要多少数据才能获得。 我们在此表明,一个模型在其余培训数据方面的总体进展取代了被扣下的数据。 我们扣下了国际象棋、奥赛罗、分子弦、括号语言和网络文字模型的个人技能训练信号。 据预测,较小型的模型将延迟使用未掌握的技能。 一个国际象棋模式从来没有经过明确的训练来应对检查,几乎对法律反应以及一个模式进行了排名。 当模型随后接受关于被扣数据的培训时,他们以初始化后需要的一小部分数据获得技能,随着模型的进步,这一分数也随之下降. 对同等困难的控制规则的了解要慢得多。 70亿参数模型的培训文本中不包含的一种编程语言也以同样的方式重新获得。 因此,数据过滤延误了能力,而重新获得能力所需的数据随着模型的改进而减少。

articles.title: A Foundation Model to Measure and Predict Human Behaviour
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to infer psychological attributes, predict individual behaviour, and simulate human populations. However, despite generating plausible responses, they often misrepresent individuals and distort population statistics. Here we introduce Chiron, a foundation model to measure and predict human behaviour. We jointly fine-tune an LLM to represent psychological constructs, predict individual behaviour, and align population response distributions with human statistics. The training and evaluation data span 36 behavioural domains and 78 social science experiments, comprising 288,307 person records, 1,411,750 atomic behavioural decisions, and 99,953 psychometric assessments over 109 psychological constructs. In our evaluations, Chiron's psychological measurements agree more closely with human self-reports and exhibit fewer biases that undermine psychometric validity. It predicts individual behaviour more accurately than frontier LLMs (up to 28.4% relative improvement). In simulations of social science experiments, it more accurately captures the direction and magnitude of human experimental effects (82.2--94.3% lower effect-size estimation error). Together, these results establish Chiron as a unified computational instrument for measuring and predicting human behaviour.

articles.title_zh: 衡量和预测人类行为的基础模式
articles.content_zh: 大语言模型(LLMS)越来越多地用于推断心理属性,预测个人行为,模拟人类人口. 然而,尽管作出了令人信服的反应,但它们往往歪曲个人,歪曲人口统计数据。 在这里,我们介绍Chiron,一个衡量和预测人类行为的基础模型. 我们共同调整了LLM,以体现心理构造,预测个人行为,并使人口反应分布与人类统计相一致。 培训和评估数据涉及36个行为领域和78个社会科学实验,包括288 307人的记录、1 411 750个原子行为决定和109个心理构造的99 953个心理测量评估。 在我们的评价中,奇伦的心理测量更接近于人类的自我报告,并表现出较少的偏见破坏心理测量的有效性. 它对个人行为的预测比边疆法学硕士(相对改善率高达28.4%)更为准确。 在社会科学实验的模拟中,它更准确地捕捉人类实验效果的方向和规模(82.2-94.3%)低效应大小估计误差. 这些结果共同确立了Chiron作为衡量和预测人类行为的统一计算工具.

articles.title: On-Policy Morphing into Hybrid Attention Models
articles.content: Hybrid attention models combine full and linear attention to achieve a better quality--efficiency trade-off. Converting pretrained Transformers into such models requires identifying which layers should retain full attention under a prescribed budget. We identify two off-policy mismatches in FlashMorph's layer selection: (i) continuous branch interpolation and teacher-forced hidden states differ from discrete hybrid computation; and (ii) frozen model weights fail to account for parameter adaptation during subsequent recovery. We introduce FlashMorph2, an on-policy layer-selection method that (I) evaluates sampled discrete hybrid architectures end to end using their own hidden states, and (II) jointly optimizes layer-selection scores and model weights under the recovery objective to reflect post-adaptation performance. Experiments across Qwen3 model scales and linear-attention variants show that FlashMorph2 consistently outperforms existing layer-selection methods, improving average scores over FlashMorph by $+2.42$ points on RULER, $+1.08$ on LongBench, and $+0.76$ on recall-intensive tasks, while completing layer selection in only $0.72$--$3.57$ GPU hours across 0.6B--8B models, demonstrating high efficiency and scalability.

articles.title_zh: 将政策推入混合关注模式
articles.content_zh: 混合关注模式将全关注和线性关注结合起来,实现更好的质量效率权衡. 将事先经过训练的变换器转换成这种模型,需要确定哪些层应在规定的预算中保持充分的注意。 我们在FlashMorph的层层选择中发现了两个不政策错配现象:(一) 持续的分支插值和教师强制隐藏状态与离散混合计算不同;(二) 冻结模型加权数在后续恢复过程中未能计入参数调整。 我们引入了FlashMorph2,一种政策层选择方法,该方法(一)评价抽样的离散混合结构最终使用自己的隐藏状态结束,(二)在恢复目标下共同优化层选择分数和模型权重,以反映适应后的表现. 跨Qwen3模型尺度和线意向变体的实验显示,FlashMorph2持续超越了现有的层选方法,比FlashMorph的平均分数在RULR上提高了2.42美元,在LongBench上提高了1.08美元,在召回密集型任务上提高了0.76美元,同时在0.6B-8B模型上只完成了0.72美元-3.57美元GPU小时的层选,显示出高效率和可扩展性.

articles.title: The Elephant in the Question: Unified Models Picture the Concepts Behind Their Answers
articles.content: Visualizing intermediate representations could help us inspect the reasoning steps underlying a model output. Unified multimodal models offer this opportunity by combining understanding and generation in one architecture. Their image generators can access representations formed while processing text. We introduce the V-lens, which uses this connection to visualize a chosen token's hidden state without training a decoder. Across four diffusion-based and two purely autoregressive unified models, the resulting images reveal key intermediate concepts that connect a question to its answer even when the concepts are never named explicitly. Controlled tests show how this content changes with context, token position, and depth. We then introduce lens tuning, which supervises selected hidden states with pictures through the V-lens. Across BAGEL, SenseNova-U1, and HunyuanImage-3.0, the rate of correct visualizations of pronoun referents rises from 2-11% to 86-94%. Surprisingly, such visual supervision also improves text answers without supervising the answer tokens directly. Code is available at https://github.com/multimodal-ai-lab/V-lens.

articles.title_zh: 问题中的大象:统一模型 描绘其答案背后的概念
articles.content_zh: 可视化的中间表示可以帮助我们检查模型输出背后的推理步骤。 统一的多式联运模式通过将理解和生成结合起来,提供了一个机会。 他们的图像生成器可以访问处理文本时形成的表达式. 我们介绍V -Lens, 它利用这个连接 直观一个选择的 代号的隐藏状态 不训练解码器。 在整个四个基于扩散的模型和两个纯粹自递性的统一模型中,所产生的图像揭示出关键的中间概念,这些中间概念将一个问题与其答案联系起来,即使这些概念从未被明确命名。 受控测试显示此内容如何随上下文,符号位置,深度变化. 然后我们引入镜头调制,通过V-Lens来监督选定的隐藏状态. 横跨BAGEL,SenseNova-U1和Hunyuanimage-3.0,代名词的正确可视化率从2-11%上升到86-94%. 令人惊讶的是,这种视觉监督也改进了文本答案,而没有直接监督答案符号. 代码见https://github.com/multimate-ai-lab/V-lens。

articles.title: Induction Head Origins of SLAM-ASR Speech Recognition Models
articles.content: What makes a small trained map from encoder states to the embedding space of a frozen language model sufficient for competitive speech recognition? The premise of the SLAM-ASR architecture is that a frozen language model possesses linguistic knowledge rich enough to perform the recognition task. This assumption, while reasonable, provides little insight into the mechanisms underlying these models. We therefore seek the concrete internal structures on which they rely. This work shows that SLAM-ASR models rely on induction heads of the frozen language model: the same heads that copy repeated token sequences in text are also important for mapping speech embeddings to transcript tokens. Moreover, we find pairs of heads that behave as a constrained form of differential attention, cancelling attention noise and sharpening attention onto the previously generated word. Finally, we show how induction heads could be used to improve transcription quality under noisy audio.

articles.title_zh: SLAM-ASR语音识别模型的简介
articles.content_zh: 是什么使得一个从编码器状态到冷冻语言模型嵌入空间的小型训练有素的地图足以进行竞争性语音识别? SLAM-ASR架构的前提是,一个冷冻的语言模型拥有足以完成识别任务的丰富语言知识. 这种假设虽然合理,但对支撑这些模型的机制却很少提供见解. 因此,我们寻求它们所依赖的具体的内部结构。 这部作品显示,SLAM-ASR模型依赖于冷冻语言模型的诱导头:在文本中复制重复的符号序列的相同的头对将语音嵌入到文本符号中也很重要. 此外,我们发现一对头像是一种受限制的差别注意形式,取消了注意的噪音,使人们更加注意以前产生的词。 最后,我们展示了如何利用上岗头来提高录音录音的录音质量。

articles.title: DRIFT: Detachable Reasoning for Runtime-Flexible and Efficient End-to-End Driving
articles.content: The integration of vision-language models (VLMs) into end-to-end (E2E) autonomous driving has demonstrated strong potential by providing scene description and reasoning capabilities. However, VLMs are computationally expensive, and switching language reasoning on and off at runtime without hurting closed-loop performance has not been demonstrated, which hinders practical adoption. To address these issues, we propose DRIFT, an E2E autonomous driving framework that integrates a lightweight language model (LM) for visual question answering and action commentary. By efficiently projecting intermediate driving representations into the language embedding space, we demonstrate that a compact LM (<150M parameters) can achieve strong scene description and action commentary. Furthermore, we introduce a runtime-flexible planning module that is trained on surrogate reasoning features distilled from the LM and can be conditioned on either the LM or the surrogate reasoning features at inference. This design enables bypassing the LM entirely when required by deployment constraints, without sacrificing driving performance. With only 255M parameters, DRIFT reaches up to a Driving Score (DS) of 97.03 and a Success Rate of 89.39% (mean over three runs) on Bench2Drive by interleaving its LM and surrogate reasoning at a chosen reasoning rate. This is on par with the strongest non-language models while being far more compact than existing VLM-based models. DRIFT further achieves competitive results on the real-world NAVSIM and AlpaSim benchmarks at significantly lower computational cost than existing VLM-based approaches. Project page: https://drift-e2e.github.io/

articles.title_zh: DRIFT:运行时间灵活高效端对端驱动的可分离理由
articles.content_zh: 通过提供场景描述和推理能力,将视觉语言模型(VLMs)整合到端对端(E2E)自主驱动中,展现了强大的潜力. 然而,VLM在计算上成本很高,运行时切换语言推理而不会伤害闭路性能,这阻碍了实际的采用. 为了解决这些问题,我们提议DRIFT,一个E2E自主驱动框架,将轻量级语言模型(LM)用于视觉问答和动作评论. 通过高效地将中间驱动表示投射到语言嵌入空间中,我们证明一个紧凑的LM(<150M参数)可以实现强烈的场景描述和行动评论. 此外,我们引入了一个运行时间灵活的规划模块,该模块对从LM中提炼出来的替代推理特征进行了培训,并且可以在推断时以LM或替代推理特征为条件。 这种设计能够在部署限制需要时完全绕过LM,而不牺牲驾驶性能. DRIFT只有255M参数,在Bench2Drive上,通过将LM和代理推理按选定的推理率进行互调,达到97.03的驱动分数和89.39%(平均超过3次)的成功率。 这与最强的非语言模型相同,但远比基于VLM的现有模型更为紧凑。 DRIFT进一步在现实世界的NAVSIM和AlpaSim基准上以大大低于现有基于VLM的方法的计算成本实现竞争结果. 项目网页:https://drift-e2e.github.io/

articles.title: Openhagen Worlds: Calibrated Environments for Measuring and Training Scientific Discovery Agents
articles.content: Agents that do science must choose informative experiments and reason from their results, but most discovery benchmarks cannot separate that skill from recall, unstated scoring rules or shortcut policies. We introduce Openhagen Worlds, a suite of 27 procedurally generated environments (some with finite truth spaces), from classic puzzles of experimental reasoning to simulator-grounded physics and chemistry, in which an agent runs experiments under a budget and commits an answer that a deterministic verifier checks against a hidden truth. Every observation states the complete scoring rule, and each of the 178 difficulty levels is calibrated: it is admitted only if, on 64 development instances, a scripted oracle succeeds on at least 0.75, the strongest plausible non-deductive policy on at most 0.25 and each gated shortcut on at most 0.35. The 92 core levels span all 27 families and are sized to train small models; the 86 frontier rungs extend the 15 discovery worlds with harder questions and with campaigns of three, five and eight or more committed stages on one hidden system. On the same 84 withheld frontier instances, one per family and rung, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash solves 32 at its default reasoning effort with 16,384 tokens per call and 57 at its maximum effort with up to 393,216 tokens per call (oracle: 79); the headroom that remains is largest in eight-stage campaigns. On-policy expert iteration gives a 9B model modest gains: its core-tier success on trained families rises from 0.090 to 0.148, partly through better action format, with no detectable loss on GPQA Diamond. A hosted service plays the core tier's withheld instances.

articles.title_zh: Openhagen Worlds:校准测量和培训科学发现代理人的环境
articles.content_zh: 从事科学的代理人必须从其成果中选择信息性实验和理性,但大多数发现基准不能将这种技能与召回、未说明的评分规则或捷径政策分开。 我们引入了Openhagen Worlds, 一套由27个程序生成的环境(有些环境有有限的真理空间), 从经典的实验推理谜题到模拟的基于物理和化学, 在其中,一个特工在预算下进行实验, 并做出一个答案, 一个决定性的验证者对照隐藏的真理来检查。 每项观察都规定了完整的评分规则,178个难度等级中的每个等级都经过校准:只有在64个开发实例中,一个脚本甲骨文至少在0.75上成功,最多0.25上最强的可信非减值政策,以及每条门口快捷键最多0.35上才能被接受. 92个核心层次覆盖所有27个家庭,规模大,以培训小型模型;86个前沿突袭将15个发现世界延伸至更困难的问题,并在一个隐蔽的系统上进行了三个、五个和八个以上承诺阶段的运动。 在同一84起被扣留的边境案件中,每户家庭和跑者1起,DeepSeek V4.1 Flash在其默认推理努力中解决32个,每个呼叫16,384个令牌,57个最大努力,每个呼叫高达393,216个令牌(oracle:79);在8个阶段的竞选中,仍然保存最大的头室. 政策专家迭代给出了9B模式的微小收益:在经过培训的家庭上,其核心层面的成功率从0.090上升到0.148,部分是通过更好的行动形式实现的,GPQA Diamond上没有可察觉的损失. 主机服务使用核心级的预留实例。

articles.title: When Does Continual Pre-Training Help? A Controlled Study of Dialectal Adaptation for Québec French
articles.content: Continual pre-training (CPT) is widely used to adapt pretrained language models to dialectal and non-standard language varieties, yet it remains unclear when this additional training is necessary, what drives its benefits, and whether aggregate evaluation scores adequately capture its effects. In this paper, we present a controlled study of CPT for Québec French language understanding across nine LLMs spanning different families and scales. Using a budget-matched protocol of 30M tokens per experiment, our results show that the benefit of CPT depends strongly on the starting model's existing competence in the target variety. When CPT is beneficial, the improvements are driven more by corpus composition than by data volume, with literary text accounting for most of the gain. Paired Québec and standard French evaluations further show that CPT primarily improves expression comprehension rather than grammatical competence, and that corpus register determines which regional expressions are acquired. These gains also involve capability-specific trade-offs, including declines in reading comprehension that aggregate scores can conceal. Overall, these findings show that CPT for dialectal adaptation should not be treated as a uniformly beneficial default. Instead, adaptation strategies should begin with a careful assessment of the base model's existing competence, accompanied by source-level data analysis and task-level evaluation.

articles.title_zh: 连续预训什么时候有用? 魁北克法语糖尿病适应控制研究
articles.content_zh: 连续的预训(CPT)被广泛用于使预训语言模型适应方言和非标准语言品种,然而仍然不清楚何时需要这种附加培训,是什么推动了其好处,以及综合评价得分是否充分把握其效果. 在本文中,我们介绍了对魁北克省欧洲防止酷刑委员会法语理解的受控研究,涉及9个涉及不同家庭和尺度的法学硕士课程。 我们的结果显示,利用每个实验3000兆令牌的预算匹配协议,CPT的好处在很大程度上取决于起始模型在目标种类方面的现有能力。 当CPT有益时,改进更多是由实体组成而不是由数据量驱动的,其中文学文本占了大部分收益. Paired Québec和法国标准评价进一步表明,欧洲防止酷刑委员会主要改进表达理解而不是语法能力,而且实体登记册决定了获得哪些区域表达。 这些收益还涉及具体能力的权衡,包括读取总分可以掩盖的理解下降。 总的来说,这些调查结果表明,不应将欧洲防止酷刑和不人道或有辱人格的待遇或处罚用于方言的调整视为一个统一有利的缺省。 相反,适应战略应首先仔细评估基准模型的现有能力,同时进行源一级数据分析和任务一级评价。

articles.title: CurvDelta: Low-Curvature Delta Modeling For Surgical Learning and Unlearning
articles.content: A central challenge in adapting large language models (LLMs) is capability preservation: an adaptation can achieve its target while degrading general capabilities. We introduce CurvDelta, a scalable framework that incorporates the preservation constraint into the parameterization of the model update. By analyzing the local geometry of the preservation constraint around the pre-adaptation model, CurvDelta constructs a low-curvature space in which parameter updates leave the preservation loss nearly invariant. We make its construction practical for LLMs through Kronecker-factored approximate curvature (K-FAC) and a factorized projection. We also introduce CurvLoRA, a low-rank variant within the same preservation geometry, designed for more efficient adaptation. Both methods apply to preservation-constrained adaptation tasks such as capability learning and selective unlearning. We evaluate our methods on mathematical reasoning, code generation, and knowledge unlearning. For mathematical reasoning and code generation, our approaches achieve competitive downstream performance while better preserving general capabilities, offering a favorable acquisition--retention trade-off relative to the baselines. For knowledge unlearning, our main results on TOFU and MUSE show a better balance between targeted forgetting and knowledge retention than the baselines, with retention performance close to the from-scratch retraining reference.

articles.title_zh: CurvDelta:用于外科学习和未学习的低温度三角洲模型
articles.content_zh: 适应大型语言模型(LLMs)的一个中心挑战是能力保护:适应可以达到目标,同时降低一般能力。 我们引入了CurvDelta,一个可缩放的框架,将保存限制纳入模型更新的参数化. CurvDelta通过分析预适应模型周围的保存约束的局部几何特征,构建了一个低曲率空间,其中参数更新使得保存损失几乎无变化. 我们通过Kronecker构件的近似曲面(K-FAC)和因子化的预测,使其LLMs的建造切实可行。 我们还引入了CurvLORA,这是同一保护几何学范围内的一个低级变体,旨在更有效地适应. 这两种方法都适用于诸如能力学习和有选择的不学习等受保护的适应任务。 我们评价我们的方法 数学推理,代码生成, 和知识不学习。 就数学推理和代码生成而言,我们的方法在下游取得了具有竞争力的绩效,同时更好地保持了一般能力,提供了相对于基线的有利收购-保留取舍。 就知识不学习而言,我们在TOFU和MUSE方面的主要结果显示,目标明确的遗忘和知识保留之间比基线更平衡,保留业绩接近于切换再培训参考。

articles.title: Piccolo: Co-Evolving Decision Models and Data through Recursive Self-Improvement
articles.content: We present Piccolo, a family of multimodal decision models (0.8B to 27B) that coevolves model capabilities and training data via Agentic Data Engineering and recursive self-improvement (RSI). The models predict probabilities over candidate answers for general-purpose text and visual judgments, agent harnesses, data workflows, and interactive games. Piccolo-27B tops the Decision Index Vision Full leaderboard with a score of 75.59, while Piccolo-9B and Piccolo-4B achieve 68.35 and 67.46, respectively. All three rank first on the Private benchmark in their respective model-size categories. Research agents analyze model behavior, construct training data, conduct experiments, and use the results to refine subsequent proposals. Semantic slices and a shared research memory connect these actions across the model family's development. With training recipes comprising hundreds of thousands of examples, data selection and feedback-driven refinement are central to the self-improvement process. Our large-scale RSI exploration yields three counter-intuitive insights for decision-model development: (1) Backbone-recipe co-adaptation outweighs raw model recency: earlier backbones can surpass newer generations on visual tasks under identical recipes; (2) Targeted data curation enables 4B-9B models to rival 27B baselines on specialized workflows; and (3) Continuous loss reduction can decouple from and even degrade discrete decision accuracy. Together with the released weights and tools from the Data-Juicer and AgentScope ecosystems, Piccolo provides an actionable blueprint for building frontier decision models and scaling data-driven RSI.

articles.title_zh: Piccolo:通过递归自我改进共同演变的决定模型和数据
articles.content_zh: 我们介绍的是Piccolo,这是一个多模式决策模型(0.8B至27B)的家族,通过代理数据工程和递归自我改进(RSI),使模型能力和培训数据共同演化。 这些模型预测了通用文本和视觉判断、代理工具、数据工作流程和互动游戏对候选答案的概率。 Piccolo-27B以75.59分的成绩登顶了决策索引"Vision Full Leaderboard",而Piccolo-9B和Piccolo-4B分别实现了68.35和67.46分. 三者在各自的模型大小类别中,在私人基准中排名第一。 研究代理人分析模型行为,构建培训数据,进行实验,并利用结果完善后续提案. 语义切片和共享的研究记忆将这些行动贯穿于模型家族的发展. 由于培训方法包括数十万个实例,数据选择和反馈驱动的改进是自我改进进程的核心。 我们的大规模RSI探索产生了三个反直观的洞察力,用于决策模式的发展: (1) Backbone-recipe co-adaptation 大于原始模型重置性:早期骨干在相同食谱下的视觉任务上可以超越新世代;(2) 定向数据重置使4B-9B模型能够在专门工作流程上与27B基线相抗衡;(3) 持续减少损失可以与离散决定精度脱钩甚至降解. Piccolo与来自Data-Juicer和AgentScope生态系统的释放权重和工具一起,为建立前沿决策模型和扩展数据驱动的 RSI提供了一个可操作的蓝图。

articles.title: Self-Rewarded Reinforcement Learning for Better-Structured Medical Explanations in Small Language Models
articles.content: Small language models (SLMs) can run on commodity hardware and support privacy-preserving, on-premises clinical deployment, but their medical explanations are often short and poorly structured compared with large language models. Recent supervised approaches such as Meerkat transfer chain-of-thought reasoning into 7B-8B backbones, yet their training objective does not directly target the style or organization of the generated rationales. Building on the instruction-tuned Mistral-7B backbone, we investigate whether a lightweight reinforcement learning (RL) step can improve explanation structure without human preference labels.We apply Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) with LoRA adaptation to 2,000 Meerkat-derived medical prompts, guided by a simple self-supervised reward that favors longer, lexically diverse, and well-punctuated responses while penalizing very short ones. Training for about 170 PPO steps on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU yields a stable increase in the average reward. Quantitative and qualitative comparisons show that the RL-tuned model produces longer, more organized, multi-point explanations while preserving the underlying medical content.We discuss the promise and the limitations of self-rewarded RL for shaping the style of medical explanations.

articles.title_zh: 自我奖励的强化学习,促进小语言模式中更好的医学解释
articles.content_zh: 小语言模型(SLMS)可以运行在商品硬件上,支持隐私保存,在前提上的临床部署,但其医学解释与大语言模型相比往往很短,结构差. 最近监督的方法,如Meerkat将思维链推理转移到7B-8B骨干,然而其培训目标并没有直接针对生成的理由的风格或组织. 基于指令调制的Mistral-7B主干线,我们调查轻量级强化学习(RL)步骤是否能够在没有人类偏好标签的情况下改进解释结构. 我们将近似政策优化(PPO)与LORA(LORA)适应2000个Meerkat衍生的医疗提示, 以简单的自我监督奖励为指导, 对大约170个PPO步骤进行单一NVIDIA A100GPU的培训,平均奖励稳步增加。 定量和定性比较表明,RL调制模型产生更长,更有条理的多点解释,同时保留基本的医疗内容. 我们讨论自我奖励的RL对塑造医学解释风格的承诺和限制.

articles.title: Clover-35B-A3B-Preview Technical Report
articles.content: We introduce Clover-35B-A3B-Preview (Clover), a mixture-of-experts diffusion language model with 35 billion total parameters and 3 billion activated parameters, supporting thinking-mode generation. Clover adapts Gated Delta Networks to block diffusion by combining recurrent memory of previously generated context with bidirectional softmax attention inside the current block. Historical memory readout competes with current-block tokens in a shared softmax, with learnable block-size calibration and a separate, zero-initialized right-context convolution branch. Clover leads the seven evaluated agent metrics, including 73.6 on SWE-bench Verified and 51.7 on Terminal-Bench 2.1. On internal agent workloads, it reaches a reported generation speed of 680 tokens/s using one NVIDIA GB300 GPU at BF16 precision and batch size one. We organize the evaluation around model quality, drafting and verification costs, and deployment under constrained memory. We also describe a decision-model variant that generates answers to related questions in one denoising pass. On an internal set of 500 groups, joint prediction raises question accuracy from 90.37% to 93.88% and all-correct group accuracy from 65.4% to 77.0%.

articles.title_zh: Clover-35B-A3B-审查技术报告
articles.content_zh: 我们引入了Clover-35B-A3B-Preview(Clover),是一种混合专家传播语言模型,总参数为350亿,激活参数为30亿,支持思维模式生成. Clover将Gated Delta Networks通过将以前生成的内存与当前块内的双向软马克思注意力相结合来进行阻断扩散. 历史记忆读出器在共享软max中与当前块符号竞争,具有可学习的块大小校准以及单独零初始化的右文本折叠分支. articles.title: Transferring an analysis of human brain organization to language models
articles.content: During human cortical development, functional systems become increasingly differentiated. We asked whether improved reasoning in language models involves a comparable regional reorganization. Applying diffusion-map embedding, used to characterize cortical organization, to matched base and reasoning-trained models from three families, we found broadly preserved gradient profiles with localized changes within a contiguous layer span. Grafting weights from these spans into instruction-tuned hosts improved mathematical reasoning on average, with gains rising with region overlap, while retaining more previously solved problems than grafts elsewhere. Across training, the span formed gradually during the early rise in performance, and grafts from intermediate stages helped. Grafts shifted most hosts partly towards their donors' behaviour and sometimes improved on problems the donors failed; the same analysis located a transferable span in a medical model. Together, these findings identify a reasoning-related region whose weights improve reasoning with low interference in the host's existing mathematical competence.
